title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
**Job Role - AI-Native Full Stack Developer**
=============================================

**About the role**
==================

We are changing how we build data governance and data quality tools. Instead of long requirements cycles, we work in very short loops: talk through a need, build it, show it, and improve it the next day.

You will work directly with a manager to build new features and functionality, with an AI coding agent such as Claude Code /Github CoPilot or Codex as the primary coder. You stay in control: you direct the agent, judge what it produces, and own what ships.

**What you will build**
=======================

You will extend our self-service data quality product, which takes a business user from connecting a dataset to a data governance dashboard.

**What you will do**
====================

* Build and ship new features across the full stack, using an AI coding agent as your main way of writing code.
* Integrate the application with Collibra and Soda through their APIs.
* Meet with a manager every day and show working, incremental progress.
* Turn short conversations into working software, without waiting for formal requirements.
* Review, test and correct what the agent produces, so that it is reliable and secure.
* Deploy your own work and keep it running.
* Keep the agent productive with good instructions, context and project structure.

**What you need**
=================

* Mid-level full stack development experience, across front end, back end and databases.
* Real, day-to-day experience building with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex or Github CoPilot
* A full understanding of how to code and deploy using AI, from first prompt to running in production.
* Enough engineering judgment to spot when the agent is wrong, and to fix it.
* A track record of working quickly and showing progress in small increments.
* Hands-on experience integrating applications with third-party platforms through REST APIs, ideally Collibra and Soda.
* Strong Python with FastAPI or similar, and React.
* Clear communication, and comfort working directly with a technical lead with little process around you.

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with data quality, data governance or data-heavy applications.
* Working knowledge of SQL databases such as Snowflake, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and MySQL.
* Experience with Docker, Microsoft Entra ID sign-in (MSAL) and automated testing (pytest, Vitest).
* Experience building agentic or LLM-based features.

**Our stack**
=============

Python and FastAPI on the back end, with SQLAlchemy and pandas. React and Vite on the front end, with Microsoft Entra ID sign-in. Soda and Collibra integrations, Snowflake and other SQL sources, and Docker.

**How we will measure success**
===============================

* Visible progress every day.
* New features turned around in days, not months.
* Working software in front of users, not long requirements documents.

**How to stand out**
====================

Show us something you built with an AI coding agent, and tell us how you directed it, what it got wrong, and how you deployed it.

title: Software Engineer - Apple Pay (WPC)
description:
Summary
  
  
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Wallet, Payments & Commerce (WPC) team is building the world’s best software for paying, and interacting with the world, from Apple Pay, transit, and event tickets, to digital keys and identity. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about their craft, crave the challenge of building systems at scale, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. If you love solving meaningful problems that impact millions of people, we want to hear from you!
  
  
Description
  
  
You'll have the opportunity to tackle the intricate challenge of building resilient and reliable distributed software systems at Apple's scale. You will be given flexibility to explore creative solutions, the support of a talented and driven team, and access to diverse technologies. You will have the autonomy and responsibility to take full ownership of your solutions.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience building and maintaining complex software systems.
* A solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals.
* A commitment to continuous learning and improvement, and curiosity for new technologies, techniques, and patterns in pursuit of engineering excellence.
* An ability to communicate thoughtfully and clearly, both verbally and in writing, to discuss complex technical concepts with diverse audiences, including global teams and external partners.
* A track record of building and sustaining healthy long-term relationships within your team, and beyond its boundaries.
* The tenacity and perseverance to drive a complex project all the way from conception to production.
* No formal degree is required. What matters most is your mindset, your initiative, and your ability to apply your skills to real-world applications

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Hands-on software development experience with Java or Kotlin and Spring.
* Development and operational experience with REST and/or gRPC services (either server-to-server or mobile client facing).
* Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
* Time spent architecting, building, supporting or otherwise working on cloud-native (e.g. AWS) applications with resilience as a core feature.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* Experience with observability tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Understanding of modern networking and experience using traffic tools for tracing.
* An appreciation for, and understanding of security, privacy, and cryptography (e.g. PKI, certificate management, JWT).
* Hands-on experience with SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g. Aurora, DynamoDB, CockroachDB, Oracle)

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

title: Senior Software Engineer – Product Testing
description:
**About Us**

Coursefinder.ai is the AI-powered study abroad platform built by KC Overseas Education — one of India's largest and most established overseas education groups. The platform serves students, counsellors, and partner universities across 1 lakh+ courses globally, with intelligent automation driving discovery, shortlisting, and application workflows.

**Job Description**  
You will own product quality end to end across web and core workflows. Working closely with engineering and product, you will plan and run testing, decide what's ready to ship, and set the quality bar the team builds toward.

**What you will do**

* Features end to end — walk complete user journeys the way a real user would, surfacing edge cases and broken states between steps, not just on isolated screens.

* Verify features work consistently across major browsers and devices.
* Own test planning and execution for new features and regression cycles and run daily release testing — you make the call on what's ready to ship.
* Test AI-powered features (recommendations, matching, agents) for output quality, not just whether they work.
* Flag performance issues — slow loads, laggy workflows, states that degrade with real data volumes.
* Test for access-control and data-leak issues across user roles.
* Log and triage bugs with precise repro steps so engineering isn't chasing you for details.
* Regression-test every fix before sign-off and set up bug-tracking and quality practices where none exist yet.

**What you bring**

* 4–7 years of hands-on manual QA on a SaaS or consumer product.
* Real experience testing AI/ML features — you can point to a specific model-behaviour bug you caught, not just a UI one.
* A sharp eye for edge cases — you find the bugs a spec never anticipated.
* Working knowledge of API testing (Postman or similar).
* Comfortable in Agile teams with frequent release cycles.
* Steady in a fast-moving environment where specs are sometimes incomplete — you ask the right questions before you start testing.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, Selenium) or basic automation scripting is a plus — this role is manual-first, but candidates who understand automation thinking write sharper, more structured manual test cases.
* Prior experience in EdTech, fintech, or another high-stakes-decision consumer product.

description:

The SAP MM/WM Functional Consultant will provide functional support for **SAP ECC Materials Management (MM) and Warehouse Management (WM)** processes within a large enterprise environment.

The role requires hands-on experience in SAP ECC configuration, production support, incident resolution, functional analysis, testing and controlled change delivery across procurement, inventory management and warehouse operations.

------------------------

* Provide functional support for **SAP ECC Materials Management (MM)**.
* Support end-to-end procurement processes including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, scheduling agreements, goods receipt and invoice verification.
* Support **Inventory Management**, including goods movements, stock transfers, reservations, physical inventory and stock adjustments.
* Troubleshoot issues relating to material master, purchasing master data, source lists, purchasing info records and vendor-related procurement processes.
* Analyse and resolve issues involving release strategies, pricing conditions, account determination and movement types.
* Support subcontracting, consignment and stock transport order processes where applicable.
* Investigate recurring incidents and contribute to root-cause analysis and permanent resolution.

* Provide functional support for **classic SAP Warehouse Management (WM) in ECC**.
* Support warehouse structures including warehouse numbers, storage types, storage sections, storage bins and interim storage areas.
* Support **transfer requirements, transfer orders, putaway, picking and stock movements**.
* Troubleshoot inventory differences and stock inconsistencies between Inventory Management and Warehouse Management.
* Support physical inventory processes within warehouse operations.
* Analyse issues relating to storage type and bin determination, movement types and WM interfaces.
* Support integration between **MM Inventory Management and WM**.

----------------------------

  + **FI** for account determination and invoice-related processes.
  + **SD/LE** for outbound delivery and picking processes.
  + **PP** for material staging and production-related goods movements.
  + **QM** for inspection stock and procurement-related quality processes.
* Work with functional and technical teams to resolve cross-module incidents.

Your existing internal MM/WM requirement similarly calls for strong SAP MM and WM configuration/support experience, procurement and inventory-management knowledge, and integration experience with FI, PP and SD. [Updated JD v0.1 | Word], [JD | OneNote]

* Support controlled transports and production releases.
* Maintain functional documentation, SOPs, known-error documentation and support procedures.

**Transition & Knowledge Management**

* Participate in knowledge-transfer, shadow and reverse-shadow activities.
* Develop a detailed understanding of existing ECC MM/WM business processes, configurations, custom developments and interfaces.

* Good understanding of MM integration with FI, SD/LE, PP and QM.

* Experience preparing functional specifications and working with ABAP developers.

* Good documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

SAP ECC - Materials Management,SAP ECC Warehouse Management

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

----------------------

**Mandatory Certification**
---------------------------

**SAP certification relevant to Materials Management / Procurement is mandatory.**

The candidate must hold a relevant **SAP functional certification applicable to the MM/procurement domain** and should have demonstrable hands-on SAP ECC MM/WM experience.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Starburst**
-------------------

Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai.

#### **About the role**

As a Senior Systems Software Engineer on the Build & Delivery team, you'll own the systems that every team at Starburst ships through — the backend services and infrastructure of one trusted, self-service, increasingly autonomous delivery platform. You will help design and build the core delivery infrastructure, as well as build "the machine that builds the machine" that is used to ship across Starburst Enterprise, Galaxy, and customer-managed deployments at scale. Daily tasks will include developing backend services and infrastructure, building operational tooling, supporting our platform in production, and driving the reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency of how we deliver software.

The problems are concrete: keep the mainline green by construction, so a red build always means a real defect; provision production-like environments on demand instead of a shared staging bottleneck; deliver testing as a service across every repo; and treat AI as a first responder for test maintenance, failure triage, and remediation.

#### **As a Senior Systems Software Engineer you will:**

* Design and build the core services and infrastructure of the delivery platform, following the immutable cloud infrastructure paradigm, consistent across Starburst Enterprise, Galaxy, and customer-managed deployments
* Build the merge-orchestration and gating systems that keep the mainline green by construction, including flaky-test detection and auto-quarantine
* Build Testing-as-a-Service — shared, on-demand test infrastructure, intelligent test selection, and unified coverage and quality gates for every team
* Build the service that provisions production-like environments on demand, so every change is proven and dogfooded before customers see it
* Design the AI workflows in the delivery loop — test maintenance, failure triage, and remediation — validated before rollout
* Own the reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency of the platform in production
* Continuously improve our engineering processes, tests, and systems that allow us to scale the code base and productivity of the team
* Provide considerate and timely review of your peers' pull requests and design proposals

#### **Some of the things we look for:**

* Passion for software engineering, with an interest in build, delivery, and infrastructure engineering in particular
* Experience designing, building, and operating distributed backend systems in production
* Experience building for reliability, scalability, and efficiency at scale
* Experience developing software in Java and Typescript
* Cloud infrastructure architecture and orchestration experience
* Experience with infrastructure as code and related tooling such as Pulumi or Terraform
* Interest in applying AI and agentic workflows to engineering problems, with a validate-then-deploy discipline
* Prior experience building CI/CD, merge queues, test infrastructure, or ephemeral environments is a strong plus
* Prior experience in developing for or operating Trino is a plus
* Demonstration of ownership, grit, and bias for action - core values at Starburst
* **Ability to Travel**: This role will require occasional in-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.

**Build your career at Starburst**
----------------------------------

All-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we're empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry-proven technology and unprecedented success, All-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry – and the future.

Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more.

We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All-Stars to show up authentically.

Starburst provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state

title: Firmware Developer - DLMS/ COSEM ( Smart Gas Metering)
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Embedded Firmware Developer to design, develop, test and maintain DLMS/COSEM-compliant firmware for battery-operated ultrasonic smart gas meters. The candidate will be responsible for embedded C development, smart metering protocols, secure communication, valve control, low-power optimisation and certification support.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain embedded C firmware for ultra-low-power ultrasonic smart gas meters.
* Implement DLMS/COSEM protocols, including OBIS codes, interface classes, DLMS services, HDLC and Wrapper communication.
* Develop metering functionalities such as flow measurement, meter indexing, billing profiles, load profiles, events, alarms and tariff management.
* Implement valve control, tamper detection and security features.
* Integrate communication modules such as NB-IoT, LoRaWAN, RF and MIU.
* Implement DLMS security, including HLS authentication, AES-128-GCM and key management.
* Develop Firmware Over-The-Air (FOTA) functionality using DLMS Image Transfer.
* Optimise firmware for long battery life (10–15 years).
* Perform firmware testing, debugging and hardware integration.
* Support product certification, conformance testing and type approval activities.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong programming experience in Embedded C.
* Hands-on experience with ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers such as STM32, Silicon Labs, NXP, Renesas or MSP430.
* Practical knowledge of DLMS/COSEM and IEC 62056 standards.
* Knowledge of UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, RTC, LCD, Flash and EEPROM.
* Experience with RTOS or Bare-Metal embedded development.
* Familiarity with JTAG/SWD debugging tools and Git version control.
* Understanding of low-power embedded system design and battery optimisation.

Standards & Protocol Knowledge

* DLMS/COSEM – IEC 62056 series.
* DLMS UA Blue Book, Green Book and Yellow Book.
* Gas Metering Standards – EN 14236 and OIML R137.
* Communication Protocols – NB-IoT, LTE-M, LoRaWAN, BLE and IEC 62056-21.
* Security Standards – AES-128-GCM and IEC 62443.
* Safety Standards – ATEX, IECEx and IEC 60079.
* IP Protection – IEC 60529.

Good to Have

* Experience in smart gas metering or ultrasonic gas metering products.
* Knowledge of NB-IoT/LTE-M AT commands and communication module integration.
* Experience with DLMS conformance and certification testing.
* Knowledge of Python-based test automation.
* Familiarity with Guru or related DLMS development tools.

Educational Qualification

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Embedded Systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant hands-on embedded firmware development experience is preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Ability to independently develop and maintain embedded firmware.
* Good understanding of hardware-software integration.
* Experience working on smart metering or IoT-based embedded products.

title: Senior MERN Stack Developer
description:
**Build it right. Ship it with confidence. Stay with it long after launch.**

Shipping a feature is the easy part. The real work starts afterward: how the app holds up when users double overnight, how quickly it bounces back when something fails, and whether the client’s product is still growing a year from now.

Techdome builds production-grade platforms for clients across FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, SaaS, Logistics, and EdTech. The industries differ, but our standards don’t: every system has to be secure, reliable, and built to scale. We’re hiring a **Senior MERN Stack Developer** to design, build, and operate full-stack applications using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js (with TypeScript), and to remain accountable for them well beyond go-live.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Own features from idea to production:** Take work through design, development, release, and ongoing support, staying responsible after launch.
* **Build full-stack products that scale:** Deliver clean React front ends and secure, well-tested Node/Express APIs backed by well-modeled MongoDB data that perform under real traffic.
* **Raise the quality bar:** Lead thoughtful code reviews and promote practices that keep codebases readable, tested, and maintainable.
* **Be the calm during incidents:** Step in when things break, restore service quickly, and run root-cause analysis so problems don’t come back.
* **Influence architecture:** Contribute to technical design and the key decisions that shape how our platforms evolve.
* **Mentor others:** Coach junior and mid-level engineers and lift the whole team’s skills.
* **Collaborate across functions:** Work closely with product, design, QA, and DevOps, with hands-on exposure to cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, and observability.
* **Think like the client:** Learn each client’s users, goals, and constraints fast, and translate them into the right technical solutions.

### **Your first 90 days**

* **Days 1–30 (Settle in and ship):** Learn our codebases, tooling, and team, and deliver your first meaningful contribution.
* **Days 31–60 (Take ownership):** Own a feature or service end to end and contribute actively in code reviews and design discussions.
* **Days 61–90 (Become a trusted owner):** Become a dependable engineer on a core client product, handle production issues with confidence, and begin guiding teammates.

### **What we’re looking for**

* 4+ years of professional experience building full-stack web applications
* Deep expertise in the MERN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js, with strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills
* Solid understanding of REST API design, MongoDB schema design and indexing, authentication and authorization, testing, and application security
* Experience with state management and performance optimization in React (e.g., Redux, React Query, code splitting)
* A track record of running production systems, not just building them
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Comfort with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and production monitoring and debugging
* Experience working across different industries or product types, with the ability to ramp up quickly on new domains
* Leadership instincts and a habit of stepping up when ownership is needed

### **Nice to have**

* Strong system design skills, including microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architecture
* Experience with Next.js, GraphQL, or WebSockets/real-time features
* Experience with Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code
* Exposure to compliance standards such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or SOC 2
* Experience integrating third-party services such as payment gateways (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen), CRMs, or analytics tools
* Consultancy or product-studio experience managing multiple clients and projects
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot

### **Why Techdome?**

* **Bootstrapped and profitable:** No investor pressure or growth-at-all-costs targets. We build for the long term.
* **A global team:** Work alongside 80+ engineers across five hubs worldwide.
* **Variety by design:** Different industries and products keep you learning.
* **Real influence:** Your ideas shape our technical direction, and your role goes well beyond closing tickets.

title: Software Development Engineer, DSP Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to be part of the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will contribute to three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces; and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents that provide actionable safety insights.  
  
This is a rare opportunity to join a team building a platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy software components for a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems
* Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed
* Develop frontend components for a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together

• Implement compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators • Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code following software engineering best practices
  

* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence activities
* Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to integrate data pipelines and model outputs into production services
* Contribute to automated evidence preservation mechanisms to address short video retention windows
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on call rotations to ensure system reliability
* Work with cross functional teams including product managers, stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, and accountability to understand requirements and deliver solutions

  
A day in the life  
You will be part of a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve writing and reviewing code for backend services, building frontend features for the safety dashboard, discussing design approaches with your team, or debugging a production issue. You will collaborate closely with data engineers and data scientists to bring data driven capabilities to life. You'll participate in sprint planning, stand ups, and retrospectives, contributing ideas to improve both the product and the development process. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow across the full stack, from data pipelines to user facing experiences, while working on a platform that scales across multiple countries.  
  
About the team  
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.  
  
We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Expert experience with Docker and Kubernetes (Helm, Ingress, ConfigMaps/Secrets) on Linux

title: GeoSpatial Developer Java
description:
**Job summary**

Serve as a GeoSpatial Developer specializing in Java to design build and optimize spatially aware applications that run on cloud native platforms. Use AWS services Snowflake data warehousing and GenAI LLM integrations to deliver robust secure and scalable solutions. Collaborate across teams in a hybrid work model to provide high impact insights from complex geospatial data.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable geospatial applications using Java to process complex spatial datasets and deliver accurate location based insights for business users.
* Implement efficient spatial data models and indexing strategies to optimize query performance and response times for high volume geospatial workloads.
* Build and integrate AWS based services including compute storage and data pipelines to enable robust cloud native processing of geospatial and tabular data.
* Create and maintain data ingestion and transformation workflows that move geospatial and related data into Snowflake for analytics and reporting use cases.
* Develop reusable services and interfaces that connect core applications with GenAI and LLM platforms to enable intelligent querying summarization and recommendation on spatial datasets.
* Collaborate with product owners architects and data engineers to translate geospatial business requirements into technical designs and implementation roadmaps.
* Optimize application code queries and resource usage to improve throughput latency and cost efficiency while maintaining reliability and quality standards.
* Implement secure access patterns masking and auditing for geospatial data on AWS and Snowflake to comply with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Create automated testing strategies for geospatial logic data pipelines and integration points to ensure predictable releases and reduced production defects.
* Prepare clear technical documentation covering system architecture data flows API contracts and operational procedures to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
* Mentor and support team members by reviewing code sharing best practices and encouraging experimentation with new geospatial and GenAI capabilities.
* Engage with stakeholders to present solution options demonstrate features and gather feedback that helps refine the geospatial product roadmap.
* Monitor production systems dashboards and logs to detect performance issues or data quality anomalies and drive timely resolution activities.

**Qualifications**

* Possess a strong background in Java development with extensive experience building backend services and geospatial features for enterprise applications.
* Demonstrate hands on expertise using AWS services such as compute storage messaging and data processing components to deploy and run production workloads.
* Exhibit solid experience with Snowflake including schema design data loading performance tuning and role based access configuration for analytics solutions.
* Show practical exposure to integrating applications with GenAI or LLM platforms including prompt design response handling and governance considerations.
* Apply knowledge of geospatial concepts coordinate systems and spatial indexing along with experience using common geospatial libraries or tools in Java ecosystems.
* Utilize proficiency in SQL and data modeling to design efficient queries joins and aggregations across both spatial and non spatial datasets.
* Communicate complex technical topics clearly to cross functional partners while working effectively in a hybrid work environment with distributed teams.
* Display strong problem solving skills and the ability to investigate production issues perform root cause analysis and implement long term corrective actions.
* Prefer experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices that automate build testing and deployment of Java and data components.
* Value prior exposure to agile delivery environments where work is planned in iterations with regular refinement reviews and adaptation to stakeholder feedback.

title: Lead Principal Platform Software Engineer
description:
Demonstrates strong expertise in building cloud services and features, with a focus on performance and scalability. Leads cross-group platform initiatives, that significantly improve reliability, performance, and compliance. Anticipates and resolves complex, ambiguous distributed systems challenges and defines compatibility and deprecation strategies to minimize downstream risk. Establishes shared observability frameworks, SLOs, and capacity models adopted across multiple teams. Partners with PSR, SRE and security teams to define architectural guardrails, security controls, and reference implementations.

  

Key Responsibilities

### **Software Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead the architecture and design of software, systems, and services; define scope, evaluate tradeoffs, and review and approve design recommendations.
* Partner with internal and external stakeholders to align architecture with business priorities and customer needs.
* Provide technical direction and domain expertise across teams, influencing architectural decisions, engineering standards, and technology adoption.
* Design for performance, scalability, accessibility, reliability, and interoperability.
* Conduct architecture reviews to ensure adherence to standards, identify improvements, and guide implementation.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices, translating findings into architectural decisions and actionable plans.

### **Software Development and Engineering Quality**

* Lead requirements analysis and solution development; establish foundational code for new projects and prototypes.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for software features and enhancements, ensuring alignment with design specifications and maintaining clear technical documentation.
* Improve practices across the software development lifecycle and coach engineers across teams.
* Lead design, code, and process reviews to improve software quality, maintainability, and delivery.
* Resolve complex software and distributed systems issues using advanced debugging and troubleshooting techniques.
* Define API integration, versioning, compatibility, deprecation, and lifecycle strategies to support interoperability and minimize downstream risk.
* Drive improvements in functional and non-functional testing, quality assurance, error logging, monitoring, and observability.

### **Performance, Reliability, and Operations**

* Lead initiatives to improve performance and scalability across products and services.
* Partner with PSR, SRE, and engineering teams to strengthen service availability, operational health, supportability, and reliability.
* Establish shared observability frameworks, service-level objectives, and capacity models across teams.
* Guide system maintenance, upgrades, patching, and validation, including remediation of critical vulnerabilities.
* Expand automation for testing, diagnostics, debugging, and maintenance to improve operational efficiency and reduce recurring issues.

### **Customer Support and Defect Resolution**

* Lead investigations into complex, high-impact customer issues, identifying root causes and defining immediate mitigations and long-term solutions.
* Provide expert technical guidance to customers and stakeholders, clearly explaining solution rationale, tradeoffs, and preventive measures.
* Coordinate across teams and business units to resolve issues promptly and maintain effective customer communication.
* Advocate for customer needs and translate feedback into product enhancements and maintenance priorities.
* Improve defect management, escalation, and training processes to strengthen support and prevent recurrence.

### **Security, Standards, and Compliance**

* Partner with security and engineering leaders to define and improve secure development practices, coding standards, and architectural controls.
* Provide technical leadership in peer reviews to ensure software meets quality standards and acceptance criteria.
* Design and implement solutions to prevent security vulnerabilities, combining automated checks with expert review.
* Promote industry best practices and coach engineers in their application throughout the development lifecycle.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **Planning and Execution**

* Provide technical leadership for critical, high-impact initiatives, coordinating scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and budgets where applicable.
* Anticipate changes in business priorities, resources, and schedules; adjust plans to maintain delivery quality and achieve intended outcomes.

### **Collaboration and Influence**

* Build alignment among cross-functional leaders, business stakeholders, customers, and external partners on strategic objectives.
* Develop lasting partnerships and identify opportunities for broader collaboration.
* Promote transparent, inclusive decision-making by actively seeking and incorporating diverse perspectives.

### **Problem Solving and Continuous Improvement**

* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex, ambiguous, or novel problems.
* Guide teams in using evidence and data to identify root causes, evaluate options, and implement durable solutions.
* Improve processes, tools, and workflows to increase engineering efficiency and effectiveness.
* Define success metrics, assess results, and refine improvements to support organizational goals.

### **Learning and Knowledge Sharing**

* Maintain deep expertise by monitoring emerging technologies, industry trends, and evolving standards.
* Share technical knowledge through mentoring, documentation, presentations, and, where appropriate, conference talks, white papers, or research contributions.
* Promote continuous learning across teams and help engineers apply new knowledge to practical challenges.

### **Talent Development and Hiring**

* Contribute technical expertise to talent planning, candidate interviews, assessments, and hiring decisions.
* Mentor engineers and peers to strengthen technical judgment, expand expertise, and support individual and team development.

---------------

We're seeking a Software Development Engineer to lead and build technical initiatives that will reshape how businesses sell on Amazon. Our team is passionate about learning and building advanced solutions using GenAI and Agentic AI to help B2B sellers optimize their operations and drive growth.  
  
Join Amazon Business 3P (Third Party - Sellers) - a rapidly growing $25B global organization where we innovate at the intersection of technology and B2B commerce. We're reimagining how sellers reach and serve business customers, creating solutions that help them grow their B2B business on Amazon. From Seller Central tools to business certifications, custom pricing capabilities, and advanced analytics, we're transforming how B2B selling happens.  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on our AB 3P Tech team, you'll work with a highly technical, entrepreneurial team building distributed systems that power the B2B selling experience. You'll drive end-to-end development from design to delivery, make strategic technology decisions, and mentor junior engineering talent. Your team will own critical systems spanning from Seller Central to Amazon Business detail pages, cart, and checkout for merchant-fulfilled offers.  
  
Join us in shaping the future of B2B selling - we're leveraging emerging AI technologies and innovating across the seller experience to create significant impact in this fast-growing business.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You'll architect and build scalable solutions using Web Services, APIs, and Micro-Services architecture. Working within our entrepreneurial team, you'll drive development of high-performance systems, implementing industry-leading design patterns and coding practices.  
  
Your role combines technical leadership with hands-on development. You'll mentor junior engineers while partnering with stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. Strong communication skills are essential as you'll lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions.  
  
You'll contribute to innovation through emerging technologies and business challenges. You'll own software engineering practices throughout the development lifecycle - from coding standards and reviews to build processes and operations, while helping establish engineering excellence.  
  
A day in the life  
You will start your day reviewing operational metrics and addressing any alerts before diving into feature development or system improvements. Expect to participate in design discussions, write and review code, and pair with teammates to solve tricky problems. You will regularly engage with product managers and stakeholders to refine priorities and ensure your work aligns with customer needs. Whether you are refactoring a critical service or documenting architecture decisions, your contributions will have a direct and visible impact.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

clinical research. At Perceptive, we help the
  
biopharmaceutical industry bring medical

* undefined

Comprehensive knowledge of Good Clinical Practice, clinical trial design, and the overall drug development process.

title: Building Management System (BMS) / Home Automation – Integration Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented **BMS / Home Automation Integration Engineer** to join our technical operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end configuration, programming, testing, commissioning, and integration of Building Management Systems (BMS), smart home automation platforms, lighting control, HVAC, and low-voltage security subsystems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **System Integration:** Execute hands-on integration of HVAC systems, smart lighting, access control, CCTV, and peripheral building control systems into unified automation platforms.
* **Protocol & Network Configuration:** Implement and configure industrial and automation protocols including **KNX, BACnet, Modbus, DALI, and TCP/IP**.
* **Programming & Commissioning:** Program, test, and troubleshoot PLCs, controllers, sensors, and actuators to ensure optimal operational performance.
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:** Conduct site testing, functional verification, and final commissioning for both commercial BMS and high-end residential smart home setups.
* **Troubleshooting & Maintenance:** Diagnose and resolve protocol communication issues, control loop failures, and hardware/software integration bugs.
* **Client & On-Site Coordination:** Work closely with project managers, MEP contractors, consultants, and clients to ensure smooth execution and handovers on site.

**Educational Qualifications & Preferred Certifications**

* **Degree/Diploma:**
* B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE)
* B.Tech / B.E. in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)
* Diploma in Electrical / Electronics Engineering
* **Certifications:** Candidates with certified training or official credentials in **KNX**, **BACnet**, or major Home Automation platforms (e.g., Schneider, Honeywell, Crestron, Control4, Lutron) will be preferred.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **3 to 5 years** of practical experience in BMS and Home Automation system integration and commissioning.
* Deep knowledge of control field equipment including sensors, valves, relays, smart switches, and actuators.
* Strong command of networking fundamentals, IP addressing, and serial bus protocols (RS-485 / RS-232).
* Familiarity with smart home ecosystem integrations, lighting scenes, energy monitoring, and UI client software.
* Excellent technical troubleshooting skills and comfortable working directly on site.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

As a **Staff Software Engineer** in the Enterprise Data Protection (EDP) team, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for designing, building, and delivering highly scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native data protection solutions.

This is a deeply hands-on role for an engineer who combines **strong architectural and engineering depth, practical AI expertise, and an aggressive delivery mindset**. You will be expected not only to solve complex technical problems, but also to drive solutions from ambiguity to production with speed, ownership, and engineering excellence.

Your responsibilities will include:

* **Own architecture and technical direction** for complex capabilities within the EDP platform, translating product and business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready solutions.
* **Drive complex initiatives end-to-end**, from technical exploration and architecture through implementation, testing, rollout, operationalisation, and production stabilisation.
* Design and build highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems and microservices using **Java and modern cloud-native technologies**.
* Provide technical leadership for EDP capabilities spanning **AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), hybrid, and on-premises environments**.
* Apply strong distributed-systems fundamentals to challenges involving data protection, backup and restore, large-scale data movement, orchestration, resiliency, security, and failure recovery.
* **Bring practical AI expertise to engineering.** Identify opportunities to use AI, generative AI, agents, and AI-assisted development to accelerate software engineering, improve product capabilities, automate operational workflows, and increase developer productivity.
* Rapidly prototype and validate AI-driven solutions, and convert successful experiments into secure, reliable, production-quality capabilities.
* Promote effective use of **AI-assisted software development** across design, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, documentation, and troubleshooting while maintaining appropriate engineering judgement and quality controls.
* Demonstrate an **aggressive delivery mindset** by breaking large problems into incremental outcomes, removing technical blockers, making pragmatic decisions, and maintaining strong execution momentum without compromising critical quality, security, or reliability requirements.
* Make thoughtful technical trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, maintainability, operational complexity, and business impact.
* Establish and raise engineering standards around architecture, coding, APIs, observability, testing, security, performance, deployment, and operational readiness.
* Lead technical design and code reviews and actively contribute production-quality code for critical components.
* Diagnose complex production and distributed-system issues across application, infrastructure, database, networking, and cloud layers.
* Identify architectural and technical debt proactively and drive improvements that simplify the platform and increase engineering velocity.
* Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, engineering managers, QA engineers, SRE/DevOps teams, and other engineering organisations to deliver business-critical capabilities.
* **Mentor and technically influence engineers across the team**, helping raise the overall engineering bar without requiring formal management authority.
* Take ownership beyond individual features by identifying gaps, challenging assumptions, proposing solutions, and driving them to measurable outcomes.

**About the Team**

The **Enterprise Data Protection (EDP)** team develops Teradata’s comprehensive data protection and migration solutions designed to support customers on their journey to the Autonomous Knowledge Platform.

Built on a modern microservices architecture, EDP delivers secure, reliable, and efficient data protection and migration capabilities while providing critical assessment, validation, monitoring, and error-detection capabilities.

The platform operates across public cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments and is designed to provide enterprise customers with a seamless and trusted data protection experience at scale.

As a Staff Engineer within EDP, you will have an opportunity to influence both the **technical evolution of the platform and how the organisation uses AI to build and operate the next generation of data protection capabilities.**

**What Makes You a Strong Candidate**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience**, with demonstrated ownership of complex enterprise or cloud-native systems.
* Strong hands-on programming expertise in **Java**, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, concurrency, performance optimisation, and software design principles.
* Strong understanding of **distributed systems**, including scalability, high availability, fault tolerance, consistency, asynchronous processing, and failure-recovery patterns.
* Proven experience designing and delivering **microservices and cloud-native applications** using containers and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud platform, **AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP**, with an understanding of cloud compute, storage, identity, networking, security, and observability concepts.
* Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, data management, and enterprise-scale data systems.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting capabilities across Linux, applications, databases, networking, and distributed environments.
* Demonstrated experience taking **large or ambiguous technical problems from concept to production** and driving execution across multiple engineers or components.
* **Hands-on experience applying generative AI and AI-assisted development techniques** to real engineering problems. Candidates should be comfortable using AI beyond basic code completion, including areas such as design exploration, code generation, automated testing, debugging, documentation, operational automation, or AI-powered product capabilities.
* Strong understanding of software quality practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, secure development, and production readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across teams without relying on organisational authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to engineering, product, and leadership audiences.
* A strong bias for action, accountability, and **rapid delivery of measurable customer and business outcomes**.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep experience with **AWS, Azure, or GCP**, particularly storage, compute, identity, container, and data-management services.
* Experience designing or operating enterprise **backup, restore, disaster recovery, data protection, replication, or large-scale data movement platforms**.
* Experience building or integrating **AI/ML or Generative AI capabilities**, including LLM-powered applications, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, model APIs, evaluation, and production observability.
* Experience with modern AI development frameworks and platforms such as **LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies**.
* Experience with **Kubernetes**, container orchestration, infrastructure automation, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
* Knowledge of security concepts such as encryption, identity and access management, secrets management, data immutability, and secure cloud architecture.
* Experience designing APIs and asynchronous/event-driven architectures.
* Experience with DevOps/SRE principles, CI/CD pipelines, telemetry, monitoring, and production operations.
* Knowledge of Teradata databases or other enterprise-grade RDBMS/data platforms.
* Demonstrated success mentoring senior engineers and raising engineering practices across a team or organisation.

title: Software Engineer — Search & Indexing Platform, Apple Ads
description:
Summary
  
  
Apple Ads helps developers and businesses reach customers on the App Store through highly relevant, privacy-focused advertising. Our engineering teams build the infrastructure that powers ad delivery at Apple scale — from search and retrieval to auction, ranking, and measurement.
  
  
Description
  
  
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the team responsible for Apple Ads' core search and indexing platform — the system that retrieves the most relevant ad candidates in response to real-time search queries across our ad placements. This platform operates at massive scale, handling tens of thousands of requests per second with strict latency requirements, and indexes millions of advertiser campaigns with complex targeting signals. We are investing heavily in evolving this platform: transitioning from batch-based architectures to streaming-first, near-real-time indexing, building modular retrieval infrastructure that scales efficiently across multiple ad placements, and introducing on-device ML scoring at retrieval time. You will have the opportunity to work across the full search stack — from index construction pipelines and data ingestion, to query execution, candidate ranking, and production reliability.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 3+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on backend or distributed systems
* Strong programming skills in one or more of: Rust, C++, Java, or Scala
* Deep understanding of search and information retrieval fundamentals — inverted indexes, posting lists, forward/reverse index construction, tokenization, query parsing, and sharding
* Hands-on experience building and operating high-throughput, low-latency distributed services with tight SLA requirements
* Experience with streaming data infrastructure such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, or equivalent systems
* Familiarity with container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes) and operating services in large-scale cloud environments

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience with embedding-based retrieval (EBR) or approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search systems
* Background in advertising technology — ad serving, candidate retrieval, auction systems, bid resolution, or L1/L2 ranking pipelines
* Experience deploying ML models in latency-sensitive inference environments, including feature serving and model lifecycle management
* Familiarity with A/B experimentation platforms and offline evaluation pipelines for ranking and retrieval
* Experience designing and migrating systems from batch-only to streaming-first architectures
* Track record of improving developer tooling and code quality in large, collaborative codebases — including test coverage automation, schema management, and CI/CD pipeline improvements

Ad Delivery Services sit on the critical path of every impression Apple Ads serves. Each capability is a low-latency service called inline during ad serving, plus the offline pipelines that keep it accurate. * Solid understanding of service design fundamentals — REST/gRPC APIs, timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, and graceful degradation
* Experience with streaming data infrastructure such as Apache Kafka or equivalent

title: Software Engineer - AI and Data Platforms
description:

The Applied Machine Learning team within the AI and Data Platform organization is at the forefront of driving digital transformation through machine learning across Apple’s enterprise ecosystem. We build and operate large-scale ML, GenAI, inference, and data platforms that power business-critical workflows across Apple. Our systems sit on the critical path of real-time decisioning—every transaction across Apple Online Store, Retail, Media, and Support systems depends on our platform’s ability to make fast, accurate fraud decisions. This requires solving complex challenges in distributed systems, extreme scale (up to 100x traffic bursts), and low-latency processingusing a diverse set of open-source and cutting-edge technologies. This role is part of the Reliability & Platform Engineering (SRE) team, but it is not a traditional or legacy operations role. Instead of reactive support, the focus is on building the platform itself—designing scalable systems, creating intelligent automation, and developing tools that redefine how reliability is engineered. You will work on developer-first platform capabilities, apply AI/GenAI-driven approaches to observability and operations, and take ownership of systems end-to-end. This role combines software engineering, distributed systems, and platform architecture, with a strong emphasis on building solutions—not just operating them.
  
  
Description
  
  
We are looking for engineers with strong coding skills and solid computer science fundamentals who are passionate about building resilient, high-performance distributed systems and platform infrastructure. As a Software Engineer in AI & Data Platform Reliability Engineering, you will work on systems powering GenAI, ML inference, and real-time fraud decisioning at scale. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on system design, platform development, and intelligent automation. You will: Design and build developer-first platform components that enable seamless onboarding and execution of ML workflows Develop automation, internal tools, and AI-driven solutions to enhance observability, reliability, and operational efficiency Build and operate multi-tenant, distributed systems handling high-throughput and highly concurrent workloads Work on systems that scale to extreme traffic spikes (up to 100x BAU) with strict latency and availability requirements Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful platform capabilities and customer-facing features Lead projects end-to-end—from architecture and design to deployment and production excellence Continuously improve system performance, scalability, and resilience Proactively identify, diagnose, and solve complex system and production challenges We are looking for engineers who enjoy going deep into systems, understanding how they behave at scale, and building smart, scalable solutions on cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, hybrid cloud).
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical field
* 3+ years of strong programming experience in Python or similar languages
* Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals
* Experience with cloud-native technologies (Kubernetes, containers, AWS or similar platforms)
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code and automation tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible)
* Ability to read, understand, and work effectively with large open-source codebases

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Excellent analytical & problem solving skills.
* Exposure to Machine Learning and GenAI technologies.
* Exposure to datasets management and cost optimisation in cloud.
* Exposure to Ray and Ray Serve, for building scalable, distributed, and model-serving platform components.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Job Description:

We are hiring a Senior SDET for Quality Assurance team. You will design and grow Playwright automation and the tooling around it, and you will use AI across the quality lifecycle: requirements analysis, test authoring, coverage review, debugging, and reporting. You will also own functional quality for your assigned applications. That includes manual and exploratory testing when human judgment is the better instrument. Automation and AI take the repeatable work so your manual effort goes where it adds the most value. You will work on applications that support ICE financial-markets infrastructure. A miss here is not cosmetic: defects can affect trading, clearing, data integrity, or regulatory evidence. We need someone who tests with that risk in mind. This is a hands-on Senior individual contributor role. You will influence design through code, reviews, and pairing. You will not manage people, and you will not be the sole owner of the organization-wide framework.

**Responsibilities**

* Test automation
  + Design, build, and maintain Playwright automation across UI, API, and integration layers.
  + Evolve the shared framework: page and component abstractions, fixtures, test data, environment configuration, CI/CD integration, and reporting.
  + Apply automation standards and design patterns that keep suites fast, reliable, and readable.
  + Reduce flakiness and improve execution speed through metrics and root-cause analysis.
  + Run automated suites in CI/CD and partner with DevOps on environments and pipeline reliability.
* AI-enabled quality workflow
  + Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to accelerate automation authoring, refactoring, debugging, and maintenance.
  + Use AI tooling to review requirements for ambiguities, missing edge cases, and untestable criteria before development begins.
  + Generate test cases from requirements, then refine, consolidate, and prioritize them with engineering judgment. You own the final suite, not the model.
  + Find coverage gaps, duplicate effort, and weak assertions in existing suites.
  + Adopt and extend AI tooling where it pays off. Building custom agent skills or MCP servers is a plus, not the core of the job.
* Functional test ownership
  + Own functional coverage and test strategy for assigned applications across UI, services, and integration points.
  + Decide what to automate and what to keep manual based on risk, stability, execution frequency, and maintenance cost. Expect a mix of automation and exploratory work, weighted toward automation once a flow is stable.
  + Perform manual, exploratory, and scenario-based testing where human judgment matters most.
  + Triage, reproduce, and document defects, and drive them to resolution.
  + Provide evidence-based release readiness to engineering and product leadership.
  + Produce clear reporting on coverage, execution results, defect trends, and release risk.
* Technical influence
  + Raise the quality of automation through code review and pairing with QA engineers.
  + Share practical patterns for automation, AI-assisted testing, and when manual testing is still the better approach.
  + Partner with software engineers, product managers, and DevOps to move quality work earlier in the delivery cycle.
* What you will work with
  + Playwright, TypeScript or JavaScript, Node, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
  + AI coding agents used as part of normal engineering work.
  + Jira and Xray (or equivalent) for defects, plans, and execution evidence.
  + API testing against REST and, where present, GraphQL.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* 7+ years in software quality engineering or SDET roles, including 5+ years of hands-on test automation.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright or a comparable modern E2E framework (Cypress, WebdriverIO, or similar), including suite structure, test data, and CI execution—not only recording or copying tests.
* Strong TypeScript or JavaScript and sound software engineering fundamentals: modular design, version control, code review, and refactoring.
* Applied experience using AI-assisted engineering tools in a routine workflow (coding agents, AI-assisted test authoring, or AI-supported requirements and code analysis).
* API test automation experience across REST or GraphQL.
* Experience contributing to a test automation framework and integrating automated tests into CI/CD.
* Strong functional testing foundation: test design techniques, risk-based prioritization, boundary and negative testing, and structured exploratory testing.
* Working knowledge of Jira, Xray, or equivalent defect and test management tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication. Test plans, defect reports, and quality summaries should be usable asynchronously.
* Ability to work on-site in Atlanta five days per week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep Playwright experience: framework architecture, flakiness mitigation, test data strategy, and execution at scale in CI.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and AI tools.
* Experience creating AI agent skills, custom agents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
* Contract testing experience.
* Experience helping a QA team adopt automation and AI practices in a practical, sustainable way.
* Background in a regulated or high-reliability domain, ideally financial markets, trading, clearing, or market data.

title: Lead Consultant - Software Engineering
description:
Responsibilities:

This role is part of the Integration team responsible for the enterprise Managed File Transfer capability. The Senior Consultant will serve as the technical SME and technical lead for the GoAnywhere platform, providing deep technical expertise while driving platform architecture, engineering standards, operational stability, and future strategy.

The position requires 15+ years of overall technology experience, with strong expertise in enterprise integration and Managed File Transfer platforms, particularly GoAnywhere. The individual will provide technical direction to the engineering team, lead complex solution and architecture decisions, and help establish and mature the GoAnywhere capability within GCH.

The role will also be instrumental in enabling upcoming transitions and positioning the team to support future enterprise integration requirements.

### **Core Technologies**

* **Managed File Transfer:** GoAnywhere MFT
* **Cloud:** AWS
* **Infrastructure as Code / Automation:** Terraform
* **DevOps / Source Control:** GitHub
* **ITSM:** ServiceNow
* **Planning & Collaboration:** JIRA, Confluence
* **Methodology:** Agile
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, SDLC, security, infrastructure and enterprise integration practices

### **GoAnywhere Technical Leadership & Strategy**

* Serve as the **GoAnywhere technical SME and technical authority**, providing direction and guidance to engineers supporting the platform.
* Define and drive the **technical roadmap and future strategy for the GoAnywhere MFT platform**, aligned with enterprise integration and technology direction.
* Lead architecture and solution design for complex Managed File Transfer and enterprise integration requirements.
* Establish engineering standards, design patterns, operational practices and reusable solutions for the GoAnywhere platform.
* Provide technical leadership for the transition of GoAnywhere capabilities and knowledge from HO to GCH, reducing dependency on individual expertise over time.
* Provide technical leadership and solution oversight for upcoming **BEAM and SEA transitions**, as well as future integration initiatives.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, cloud, security and integration teams to design scalable and supportable solutions.

### **Platform Engineering & Architecture**

* Architect, administer and evolve GoAnywhere MFT environments across non-production and production environments.
* Lead complex installation, configuration, migration, patching and platform upgrade initiatives.
* Provide expertise across GoAnywhere projects, workflows, schedulers, monitors, partner configurations and secure file-transfer patterns.
* Design solutions leveraging secure transfer protocols including SFTP, FTPS and HTTPS.
* Provide technical oversight for AWS infrastructure supporting GoAnywhere, including EC2, Load Balancers, VPC, Route53, S3, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, Certificate Manager and CloudWatch.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform, including development of scalable and reusable modules and automation patterns.
* Drive appropriate use of GitHub and CI/CD practices for platform engineering and infrastructure changes.

  
Qualifications:

* **15+ years of overall IT experience**, with significant experience in enterprise integration, middleware, Managed File Transfer or related platform engineering.
* Deep hands-on expertise with **GoAnywhere MFT** in large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience providing technical leadership for enterprise platforms or integration services.
* Strong experience designing and supporting GoAnywhere on **AWS**.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience, particularly **Terraform**.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and secure file-transfer technologies.
* Experience with enterprise-scale platform upgrades, migrations, DR, security remediation and production support.
* Strong understanding of AWS infrastructure, networking, IAM, security, monitoring and resiliency concepts.
* Experience working with CI/CD, GitHub, ServiceNow, JIRA and Confluence.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues spanning application, infrastructure, network, database and integration layers.
* Experience influencing architecture and engineering decisions across multiple technical teams.

**Leadership Qualities**
------------------------

* Recognized **SME who can operate independently and provide technical direction to others**.
* Able to move between strategic platform discussions and hands-on technical problem solving.
* Strong technical decision-making and ability to navigate ambiguity.
* Able to influence teams and stakeholders without requiring direct reporting authority.
* Strong communicator capable of explaining complex technical topics to both engineering and leadership audiences.
* Demonstrates ownership and accountability for platform stability, engineering quality and technical outcomes.
* Strong mentoring mindset with a focus on building capability within the broader team.
* Forward-looking and able to identify how the platform needs to evolve to support future enterprise integration needs.

title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer
description:

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Medtronic CRM Application Development team develops the next generation medical technologies that save lives and improve quality of living for millions of patients across the world. The CRM Software team works across application, network, mobile, BT/BLE communication, and embedded software that supports the management and control of implantable medical devices. We are seeking a proactive, self-starting Senior Software Test Automation Engineer who will serve as a critical automation expert, with deep hands-on experience in Appium-based mobile test automation, to design, develop, and maintain scalable automation solutions for the next generation of CRM software.  
  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* **Appium automation expertise (mandatory):** Provide hands-on technical leadership for designing, developing, reviewing, and maintaining robust mobile automation solutions for Android and iOS applications.
* **Automation framework ownership:** Architect and enhance reusable, scalable, and maintainable test automation frameworks; establish coding standards, review automation code, and drive reliable execution across releases.
* **Test design and development:** Translate requirements and risk areas into effective automated test scenarios, reusable components, and maintainable regression suites.
* **CI/CD integration:** Integrate automated test execution, reporting, and quality gates into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery pipelines and support reliable, repeatable release validation.
* **Mentoring and coaching:** Mentor engineers in Appium, automation design, coding practices, debugging, and test strategy; provide constructive reviews and coach the team to improve technical capability, quality ownership, and engineering discipline.
