* **Version Control** : Proficiency in using version control systems like Git is essential for managing and collaborating on automation scripts.
* **Databases and SQL:** Understanding databases and SQL is helpful for accessing and manipulating data during testing.
* **Debugging and Troubleshooting:** Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills are necessary to identify and fix issues in automation scripts and test environments.
* **Performance, Security, and Regression Testing** : Experience in these types of testing, particularly in an automated context, can be a significant advantage.
* **Analytical Thinking:** The ability to analyze requirements, identify potential issues, and design effective test strategies is crucial.
* **Attention to Detail:** Thoroughness and attention to detail are essential for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of automation scripts and test results.
* **Problem-Solving:** The ability to diagnose and resolve issues in automation scripts, test environments, or software under test is vital.

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

  

* Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in Computer Sciences, Biotechnology, Bio-Medical, Electronics or Electrical Engineering from a premium institute.
* Preferred: Maters in Engineering or master’s in technology computer sciences, Biotechnology, Bio-Medical, Electronics or Electrical Engineering from a premium institute.
* 8 - 12 years of Software industry experience.

* Advanced, hands-on experience with **Appium** for mobile application test automation, including framework development, element identification, synchronization, debugging, execution, and reporting across **Android and iOS** .
* 5+ years of experience designing and architecting software test automation frameworks, with demonstrated ownership of scalable solutions and automation strategy.
* Strong programming and automation-scripting fundamentals, including object-oriented design, reusable component development, debugging, and code reviews.
* **C#/.NET experience is good to have** ; experience with Java or another relevant automation language is also valuable.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining automated tests for mobile applications and validating integrations with embedded systems.
* Strong experience with mobile automation tools and ecosystems, with **Appium as the primary required tool** ; exposure to Selenium, SeeTest, or equivalent tools is beneficial.

* Familiarity and understanding of one or more of the following tools: Visual Studio, Automated test tool Microsoft Test Manager, Web based applications, Eclipse, Visual Source Safe, and Requisite Pro.

* Strong working knowledge of **Android and iOS** platforms, mobile application behavior, device/emulator management, and mobile test-environment troubleshooting.

* Familiarity with both Agile and Waterfall software development methods.

* Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers, conduct effective automation code and design reviews, share technical knowledge, and raise team capability.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery and quality metrics, with the ability to interpret trends, connect measures to delivery and product risk, and use data to guide team-level continuous improvement.
* AI-first problem-solving mindset and practical understanding of how AI-assisted techniques can improve verification productivity and quality, including appropriate human oversight, validation of outputs, data protection, and responsible use.

* Ability to test, analyze, and solve technical problems.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Design/test experience working with regulated medical devices, preferred.
* Experience working within a regulated environment is preferred.
* Local language test experience is preferred.
* Experience with software version control tools is preferred.
* Quality focus, willingness to learn, versatility and adaptability.
    
  **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in regulated medical-device software testing and **hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing** , including test setup, device communication, integration validation, and troubleshooting; web application automation experience is also beneficial.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent written, organizational, and communication skills is required, and have a flexible and team-oriented attitude.
* Self-motivated and positive
Ability to quickly establish credibility with all levels of customer base.

title: Software Engineer – Automation & ServiceNow
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

**What to know:**

* Commvault does *not* conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

  

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

**The Opportunity:**

We have an exciting opportunity to join our Business Technology team. As we move toward an AI-driven delivery model, you will design and build end-to-end workflows that orchestrate ServiceNow, cloud platforms, enterprise systems, and AI agents into autonomous flows that resolve requests from intake through completion.

The ideal candidate starts with business outcomes and economics—understanding current costs and cycle times, defining target states, and designing the fastest path to achieve them. You will re-engineer processes before automating, determine what can be resolved autonomously versus requiring human intervention, and build the integrations that bring these solutions into production.

### **What you’ll do…**

* Orchestrate cross-platform workflows connecting ServiceNow, cloud services, identity systems, and enterprise applications to enable end-to-end request resolution without manual handoffs
* Build AI-powered request resolution and autonomous operations (intent detection, diagnosis, and resolution), driving deflection before tickets are created
* Integrate AI agents into workflows using MCP, tools, and orchestration patterns to pull context, take action, and escalate appropriately
* Re-engineer processes before automating—eliminating unnecessary steps and designing improved workflows
* Own automation economics and value realization, including measuring cost and cycle time, modeling improvements, and tracking business impact
* Build and configure solutions on ServiceNow (Flow Designer, Integration Hub, scoped apps, catalog, Now Assist) alongside automation beyond the platform
* Develop automation outside of ServiceNow using Python and PowerShell for cloud operations, identity management, monitoring, and scheduling
* Design workflows that balance automation and human oversight—defining approval points, autonomy boundaries, and ensuring systems operate reliably and safely in production

### **Who you are?**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, automation, or ServiceNow development, building production-grade solutions
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow development, including workflow automation (Flow Designer), integrations (REST/webhooks), and platform scripting
* Experience working with authentication (OAuth, bearer tokens) and enterprise data models (e.g., CMDB)
* Strong automation mindset with the ability to identify what should be orchestrated, automated, or eliminated
* Solid engineering fundamentals (APIs, system design, data structures, scripting)
* Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C#, or PowerShell
* Experience building and integrating systems using REST APIs and enterprise platforms
* Experience delivering end-to-end automation (design, build, deploy, monitor, measure)
* Ability to work backward from business outcomes, with a focus on impact and efficiency
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated self-learning mindset in a rapidly evolving technology landscape
* Curiosity to understand root causes—building solutions that address patterns, not just symptoms
* Strong written and verbal English

### **Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Experience across additional ServiceNow modules (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, GRC)
* Familiarity with ServiceNow capabilities such as Service Portal, UI Builder, Performance Analytics, Now Assist, or Virtual Agent
* Experience building scoped applications (App Engine) and using automated testing frameworks (ATF)
* Experience applying AI to workflow automation (e.g., request deflection, automated resolution, intent classification at scale)
* Exposure to agent-based systems or orchestration patterns (e.g., MCP, tool integration, agent handoffs)

title: Sr DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

10

**Role:**

Senior DevSecOps Engineer – Enterprise Developer Platform and Toolchain

  

**The Team**

The Enterprise Developer Platform & Toolchain team owns the platforms, tools and capabilities that support software engineers across S&P Global. Our core functions span DevOps, DevSecOps, FinOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Developer Experience (DevEx). We partner with divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Information Security (InfoSec) to establish consistent controls and governance across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a globally distributed team, we build services, policies and automated controls that secure the developer toolchain while keeping platforms simple, consistent and engineer friendly.

  

**The Impact**

You will embed security governance into the software delivery lifecycle by translating requirements into clear policies and automated controls. Your work will protect source control, CI/CD pipelines, build infrastructure and the software supply chain without creating unnecessary friction for engineers. You will strengthen credentials, secrets and non-human identity governance; drive security findings through to remediation; and contribute to AI-assisted development governance and developer endpoint security. Working with platform teams, divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs), you will support audit and compliance and make secure practices the default across S&P Global.

  

**What’s in It for You**

Help shape how thousands of engineers build and ship software securely. You will work hands-on with enterprise security tooling and emerging areas such as AI tool governance and policy as code. You will own controls end to end, from policy design to automated enforcement, and collaborate with InfoSec, audit and engineering leaders. We support your growth through innovation projects, training, certification support and knowledge sharing.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define and implement baseline security policies and automated guardrails across source control and CI/CD environments.
* Integrate, manage and tune code quality and application security tools, including SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), Checkmarx and Wiz, within developer workflows.
* Triage security findings, prioritise vulnerabilities by risk and track remediation against service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Establish governance for credentials, secrets and non-human identities across the developer toolchain.
* Harden build infrastructure and software supply chain controls, including artifact management with JFrog Artifactory/Xray.
* Provision, secure and optimise AWS services supporting the developer platform, including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM and CloudFormation/CDK.
* Contribute to governance for AI-assisted development tools and developer endpoint security.
* Monitor sensitive configuration changes, implement alerting and support audit and compliance activities.
* Partner with platform and engineering teams to automate security controls and drive adoption.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5–8 years of experience in DevSecOps, application security or security governance.
* Strong experience designing and automating enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines, with an understanding of source control security and common pipeline threats.
* Hands-on knowledge of GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, runners, rulesets and policies.
* Strong understanding of repository lifecycle management and Git practices, including Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, trunk-based development/GitFlow and pull request workflows.
* Hands-on experience with static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning or cloud security tools.
* Ability to write clear security policies and standards and translate them into technical enforcement.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, including single sign-on (SSO), role-based access control (RBAC) and least privilege.
* Proficiency with infrastructure as code, including Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK, and familiarity with configuration management tools.
* Experience with AWS compute, networking, storage, IAM and container orchestration (ECS/EKS), including AWS security practices.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Bash; familiarity with TypeScript/Node.js.
* Understanding of configuration management databases (CMDBs) and ITIL-aligned change management, including approvals and audit trails.
* Awareness of AI tool governance and developer endpoint security, including mobile device management (MDM).
* Strong communication skills and the ability to influence adoption across engineering teams.
  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot and Cursor IDE, and developer agents/MCP integrations.
* Contributions to open-source Backstage plugins or internal developer platform (IDP) ecosystems.
* Familiarity with compliance as code and policy engines such as OPA or Sentinel.
* AWS certifications, such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD).
* Security certifications, such as CSSLP, Security+ or AWS Security.
  

**Technical Environment**

**Source Control & CI/CD Security:** GitHub Enterprise security features, GitHub Actions hardening, OIDC and GitHub Apps

**Application Security:** SAST/SCA tooling, including Checkmarx, SonarQube and GHAS

**Cloud & Container Security:** Wiz or similar cloud security posture management (CSPM) and vulnerability tools

**Software Supply Chain:** Artifactory/Xray or similar tooling, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and artifact signing

**Secrets & Identity:** Vault or other secrets managers, Okta or similar tooling, and non-human identity governance

**Runners & Endpoints:** Runner hardening tools and MDM

**AI Governance:** Copilot controls, MCP and agent guardrails

**Monitoring:** Splunk or similar security information and event management (SIEM) tooling

**Automation & Cloud Security:** Python, Bash, Terraform and AWS security (IAM, KMS)

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technology-related field.

**What’s In It For** **You?**

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**  
**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
  
  
Our benefits include:

* Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
* Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
* Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.

* Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. title: Sr. Statistical Programmer
description:
Sr. Statistical Programmer

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  
  
Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Uses SAS or other software to develop custom programming code to generate summary tables, data listings, graphs and derived datasets as specified in the statistical analysis plan and programming specifications.
* Works to ensure that outputs meet quality standards and project requirements. Performs validation programming and works with other Programmers, Biostatisticians, and other project team members to resolve discrepancies or any findings. Keeps project team members informed of programming progress and issues requiring their attention. Follow applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
* Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, testing, and verification/quality control documents and programs ensuring inspection readiness.
* Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects at a time, sets goals based on priorities from management, and adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload. Develops specifications for datasets and outputs of any complexity according to statistical and sponsor requirements. Anticipates and addresses potential programming issues, reflects forethought, establishes the basis for efficient programming and accurately defines all variables to be accepted by peer review and sponsor/requestor with little rework.
* Prepares in advance for internal meetings, contributes ideas, and demonstrates respect for opinions of others.
* Conducts effective internal meetings (appropriate in format, frequency and attendance). Distributes relevant information in advance. Ensures minutes are promptly and accurately distributed. Follows action items through to completion, and maintains order and focus of meetings, working toward consensus. Displays willingness to work with others and assist with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business. Negotiates and establishes accurate time estimates for completion of study programming activities with internal team members and statistical programming management, and completes project programming activities within timeframe allotted.
* Acts as the lead statistical programmer. Directs the programming activities of other programming personnel and monitors progress on programming deliverables. Reviews project documentation such as Statistical Analysis Plan, mock shells, programming specifications, annotated CRFs, and SAS database design. Provides feedback to the appropriate project team members which reflects forethought and reduces inefficiencies in programming activities.
* Participates in sponsor meetings, kickoff meetings, and bid defense meetings as statistical programming representative, as required by sponsor. Contributes to the mentoring of programming personnel through developing training courses, presenting training materials, reviewing work, and providing feedback or guiding new associates in process. Transfers deliverables. Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
* Minimal travel may be required

Qualifications:

* Undergraduate degree, preferably in a scientific or statistical discipline; in lieu of degree, an equivalent combination of education and demonstrated programming experience.
* Extensive programming experience in SAS or other required software, preferably in a clinical trial environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.

**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Your Team's Impact**
----------------------

We are looking for a talented and experienced Software Engineer III to join our Buyside Services Engineering team. In this role, you will serve as an individual contributor responsible for designing, building, enhancing, and maintaining a suite of industry-leading products that power FactSet's Portfolio Services and Managed Services business.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product Development, Analytics Engineers, and Team Leads to deliver high-quality, performant, and scalable software solutions that drive transparency, data integrity, and operational efficiency for our clients. You will take ownership of complex technical initiatives, contribute to solution design, and help improve the scalability, reliability, and maintainability of our applications.

  

The Buyside Services Engineering team drives the evolution of workflow and process monitoring tools that are critical to FactSet's managed and co-sourced operating model offerings.

Our products provide:

* End-to-end transparency from client data integration to processed data consumption
* Data validation and accuracy assurance at every stage of transformation and enrichment
* Presentation-ready outputs for performance, risk, and reporting operations
* Managed Services capabilities that shift the burden of data and process management from clients to FactSet's domain experts

Through continuous innovation and dedicated expertise, we empower clients to focus on their core competencies while we ensure the integrity, timeliness, and quality of their analytical operations.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design and develop **complex features, enhancements, and technical solutions** across our applications
* Own development activities from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support
* Collaborate with Product Development to understand business requirements and translate them into **scalable and maintainable technical solutions**
* Contribute actively to technical design discussions and evaluate solutions for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability
* Identify opportunities to improve application **performance, stability, scalability, and technical health**
* Diagnose and resolve complex production issues, identifying patterns and opportunities for preventative improvements
* Break down larger technical requirements into well-defined development tasks and deliverables
* Work with the Product Development team to prioritize and resolve production and development issues
* Champion engineering best practices through code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and thoughtful technical design
Share technical knowledge and provide guidance to less-experienced engineers through code reviews, troubleshooting, and day-to-day collaboration  

  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

You will also pioneer the team’s operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle.
* Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines.
* Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs.
* Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org.
* Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e.g., leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e.g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules.
* Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc).
* Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring.
* Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture.  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience: 6–13 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including 3+ years at the Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) or Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) level leading technical projects and distributed engineering teams.
* Project Ownership Track Record: Proven experience taking complex SaaS platforms or enterprise software projects from architectural inception to production delivery.
* Strategic Execution: Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous business requirements into high-level architecture designs, concrete technical epics, and actionable execution plans.
* Systems Engineering: Deep mastery of both Python and Java, including enterprise frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask, Spring Boot) and microservices design patterns.
* Front-End Architecture: Advanced proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular), with experience designing scalable component libraries and complex data visualization dashboards.
* AI Tooling & Innovation: Advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, paired with a strategic vision for integrating AI into technical workflows.
* Data & Cloud Systems: Strong expertise in relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL/graph databases, distributed data processing, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Regulatory Frameworks: Working knowledge of regulatory standards including NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria).
Compliance Engineering: Direct experience building or architecting systems around continuous control monitoring, automated audit trails, or policy engine evaluation (e.g., OPA/Rego).  

**Even Better If...**

* Prior experience architecting commercial GRC tools, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), or Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) systems.
* Practical experience implementing Open Policy Agent (OPA) or similar policy-as-code domain tools at scale.
* Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or Cloud Security Specialties.
Experience with Salesforce platform including Lightning Web Components, Apex, and SOQL  

  

Unleash Your Potential

title: Senior Power BI Developer - Power Platform & Dynamics 365
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role :**

  

As a **Power BI & Power Platform Developer** , you will design, develop, and support enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365. You will work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical teams to deliver scalable, high-performance dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.

  

**What Will You Do:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, and analytical solutions to support business intelligence and reporting requirements.
* Translate business requirements, KPIs, and operational metrics into intuitive, actionable, and user-friendly analytics solutions.
* Develop and optimize Power BI datasets, DAX calculations, Power Query transformations, semantic models, and data visualization components.
* Build reporting and analytics solutions leveraging data from Dynamics 365 CRM, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Dataverse, SQL databases, APIs, and other enterprise data sources.
* Develop supporting solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, and Microsoft Dataverse, including workflow automation and business process enhancements.
* Implement security, governance, Row-Level Security (RLS), access controls, refresh strategies, and reporting standards across Power BI environments.
* Provide L2/L3 support, troubleshoot data, refresh, access, reconciliation, and performance issues, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, Dynamics 365 consultants, architects, data engineers, and developers while mentoring team members and promoting best practices.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 6-10 years of experience with strong hands-on expertise in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, and dashboard development.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI, including reports, dashboards, semantic models, visualizations, workspace management, and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Advanced experience with DAX, including complex measures, calculated columns, financial calculations, KPI development, and business logic implementation.
* Strong experience with Power Query, M Language, SQL, dimensional modelling, star schemas, semantic models, relationships, and data transformation techniques.
* Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Dataverse, and broader Microsoft Power Platform capabilities.
* Experience working with Dynamics 365 CRM/Customer Engagement and/or Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, including data modelling, reporting, and analytics requirements.
* Proven experience implementing Row-Level Security (RLS), governance standards, performance optimization, CI/CD concepts, source control, and production support activities.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable analytical solutions.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Experience integrating Power BI with Dynamics 365, Dataverse, cloud platforms, APIs, and multiple enterprise data sources.
* Experience optimizing large datasets, complex DAX calculations, semantic models, dashboard performance, and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Experience supporting AMS, enhancement, modernization, and enterprise analytics transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Power Platform governance, environment management, application lifecycle management, and deployment practices.
Microsoft certifications in Power BI, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Azure Data, or related Microsoft technologies preferred.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Software Dev Engineer
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer II to join the Associate Experience team. Our organization is at the forefront of customer experience — seeking to delight our customers in every interaction they have, whether through self-serve technology and tools (e.g., chatbots), or by interacting directly with our Customer Service Associates (CSA).  
  
Customer Service works to offer effective, empathetic, and efficient issue resolution when our customers need us, and we are also champions of driving defects out of customer experiences across the entire company, relentlessly advocating on behalf of customers and keeping them at the heart of everything we do.  
  
As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will design, develop, and own comprehensive customer engagement services and solutions that anticipate and resolve customer questions at global scale. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and improvements to our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will also contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior engineers on the team. You should be somebody who thrives on solving difficult technical problems, designing scalable solutions, and feels strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset.  
  
We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design, develop, and own software services and tools that solve difficult business and operational problems, delivering with a focus on simplicity and scalability  
Optimize and enhance existing systems for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale  
Make informed technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with limited guidance  
Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle, escalating when appropriate  
Partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to design reviews, align on technical direction, and drive improvements across team boundaries  
Make effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to deliver high-quality results within project timelines  
Track, analyze, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement  
Identify and implement engineering process improvements, contributing to operational excellence and best practices across the team  
Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards  
Write clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership and team knowledge sharing  
  
A day in the life  
As a Software Development Engineer II on the Associate Experience team, no two days look exactly the same — but each one centers on building technology that makes a real difference for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) and the customers they serve. You might start your morning reviewing metrics from a recent deployment, analyzing how a feature you own is performing at scale and identifying areas for optimization. Then you could be deep in a design review with your team, debating trade-offs between approaches for a new generative AI-powered automation feature. After that, you shift to hands-on coding — writing, testing, and shipping production-quality code using test-driven development and continuous deployment practices. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product managers and other SDEs to shape technical direction and translate customer needs into scalable solutions. You also make time to review pull requests from teammates and mentor junior engineers on best practices. Some days involve investigating and resolving production issues, making quick decisions to mitigate risks and keep systems running reliably. By end of day, you have contributed meaningfully to services that touch millions of customer interactions worldwide.  
  
About the team  
The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. We build AI assistants, contact automation, and real-time insight tools that reduce CSA effort and improve the customer experience with every interaction. Our team values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about using cutting-edge technology to make a meaningful impact on how millions of customers experience Amazon support.

------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior System Software Engineer - GPU
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Senior System Software Engineer to join our Display Driver team. You will develop production-quality system software for next-generation NVIDIA GPU and Tegra platforms, working across operating systems such as Linux and Android.

The role combines broad kernel-mode driver development with opportunities to work on display security technologies, including High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP). You will collaborate with hardware, firmware, security, and system software teams to deliver reliable and secure display solutions.

  

**What you’ll be doing**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain GPU/display kernel-mode drivers and embedded firmware.
* Develop system software across Linux, Android or similar operating system.
* Implement and maintain HDCP and related display-content-protection functionality.
* Debug interactions across software, firmware, hardware, and external display devices.
* Develop multithreaded, performance-sensitive software in C.
* Participate in design, code, and security reviews.
* Build automated tests and diagnostic tools to improve reliability and interoperability.
Collaborate with teams across NVIDIA and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.  

  

**What we need to see**

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience developing system software, embedded software, firmware, or kernel-mode drivers.
* Strong C programming and debugging skills.
* Solid understanding of operating-system fundamentals, computer architecture, memory management, synchronization, and concurrency.
* Experience developing low-level software on Linux, Android, or a similar operating system.
* Familiarity with secure protocols, cryptographic concepts, authentication, key management, or content-protection technologies.

Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd**

* Experience implementing or debugging HDCP 1.x/2.x authentication and content-protection flows.
* Knowledge of HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, DDC/I²C, or DisplayPort AUX protocols.
* Experience with Linux DRM/KMS or graphics/display kernel drivers.
* Familiarity with trusted execution environments, secure firmware, hardware security modules, or secure key provisioning.
* Experience in debugging display interoperability, or content-protection certification issues.

title: Software Engineer-Fabric Digital & AI
description:
**Company Description**

We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

Analyze existing SharePoint and Microsoft 365 solutions to identify improvement opportunities and address business requirements. Implement enhancements, change requests, and configuration updates. Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root-cause analysis, and support ongoing platform optimization.

Collaborate with business stakeholders, project team members, quality assurance resources, and technical teams to support solution delivery. Review, validate, and interpret business, functional, and non-functional requirements. Develop and support integrations using APIs and related technologies. Work with business analysts and business contacts to ensure solutions meet operational requirements and user needs.

### **6. Other Duties as Assigned**

Maintain technical and operational documentation, support governance and compliance activities, participate in knowledge sharing, evaluate relevant Microsoft 365 capabilities, and perform other duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  
  

### **EXPERIENCE**

* 5+ years of SharePoint Online administration and development experience.
* Strong knowledge of SharePoint administration, permissions, governance, patterns, and site configuration.

  + PnP Modern Search

title: Senior Software Engineer - C#, .Net & ASP.Net Core
description:

title: Sitecore Developer
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

The Software Engineering Specialist 1 role works within our agile/scrum Product Engineering team to own major engineering initiatives. This role delivers successfully in a variety of core frameworks, patterns, and methodologies. The role influences the technical craft of the team and often serves as a source of answers to others on a team-wide level.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Demonstrates strong competence in a variety of core technology frameworks, patterns, and methodologies.
* Translates complex technical need into meaningful solution and guides others to understanding.
* Influences and at times set direction on tools, standards, and other way of work items for immediate team.
* Ensures software meets all requirements of quality, security, scalability, extensibility, etc.
* Identifies Proof-Of-Concepts for new solutions and/or technologies and provides pro/con inputs to the team for decision making.
* Effectively communicates risks, trade-offs, pro/cons from a technical perspective to allow informed decisions.

**Skills:**

* **Communication** - Communicates with organization. Helps others in the team to communicate.
* **Empathy & Humility** - Trusted by peers and your team. Can take any problem team and help them drive in the same direction.
* **Initiative** – Uses your own judgment to make decisions without asking another person's advice.
* **Objectivity & Adaptability** - Takes problems outside your skillset and quickly adapts to solve them. Helps others do the same.
* **Growth Mindset** – Not happy unless outside comfort zone. Comfortable with unknowns, with a relentlessly positive outlook on change and risk. Quick to admit when you do not know.
* **Writing Code** – Is a go-to within the team and the wider organization across multiple codebases, languages, and technology adoption. You are known as a hub of code knowledge across multiple teams. Proposes and owns the implementation of new languages and technologies, where deemed appropriate.
* **Testing** – Independently tests and advises the rest of the team on quality of tests.
* **Debugging & Monitoring** – Uses systematic debugging to diagnose all issues located to a single service and drives monitoring work across the team.
* **Technical Understanding & Prioritization** – Is a technical and prioritization leader within the team, including taking some ownership of other team members' technical growth and development.
* **Security** – Consistently approaches all engineering work with a security lens.
* **Software Architecture** – Consistently designs code that is aligned with the overall architecture. Plans accordingly for changes and impacts of changes.
* **Business Context** – Understands how the business works and the goals of their team. Relates that to your own work.
* **Product Knowledge** – Has a detailed understanding of areas of the product or ability to learn about the product
* **Culture & Togetherness** – Actively signals according to behaviors you want to see. Keeps a cool head around others even in stressful situations. Is involved in the planning and organizing of team activities.
* **Developing Others** – Recognizes strengths of peers and looks for ways to support those strengths through project work. Invests time in materials or processes to support team growth. Peers see you as an informal coach.
* **Stakeholder Management** – Known for being efficient and reliable, and doing what they say they will do. Proactively managed expectations even when it results in frustration or personal reputation risk.
* **Team Leadership** – Capable of informally managing interns, contractors, suppliers, and agencies. Possibly manages one or two junior team members. Does not look for glory and does not complain about work that needs to be done. Assumes good decisions in others’ work. Broadly, you do what you say you are going to do.

**Qualifications/Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, MIS, Information Systems or engineering fields, or equivalent experience.
* 9 – 12+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong understanding of object-orient programming (OOP) and Design Patterns.
* 3+ years of experience developing Sitecore solutions/projects
* 9+ years of experience in developing, configuring, implementing, and supporting diverse enterprise applications utilizing a n-tier architecture, the Microsoft technology stack and the .NET framework.
* 8+ years of experience in.NET development, including experience with MVC Framework, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML and CSS.
* 5+ years of experience with a JavaScript framework such as React, Angular, or similar.
* 9+ years of experience developing applications on the SQL Server platform using T-SQL, stored procedures, and functions.
* 2+ years of experience working with REST APIs.
* 4+ years of experience with agile environments.
* Experience leveraging Azure DevOps (ADO) or Jira for work item management and CI/CD automation, as well as Git for version control.
* 2+ years of experience with building SaaS solutions using Azure services such as Service Bus, Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, API Manager or other cloud technology.
* 1 or more technology certifications.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: IT Developer
description:

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The IT Developer (Salesforce) designs, develops, and supports Salesforce solutions that enable customer relationship management, sales enablement, and business process automation. This role contributes to the delivery of scalable Salesforce capabilities through application development, platform configuration, integrations, and adoption of Salesforce AI technologies while partnering with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.

* Configure and optimize Salesforce Flows, approval processes, and workflow automation following platform best practices.
* Implement Salesforce security controls including Organization-Wide Defaults, role hierarchy, sharing rules, permission sets, profiles, field-level security, and restriction rules.

Troubleshoot application issues, perform root cause analysis, and maintain high-quality code through unit testing and deployment standards.

title: AIOps Platform Engineer Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering

We are seeking an experienced Senior AIOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the autonomous agents that turn observability data into safe, closed-loop operational action. You will sit at the intersection of service observability and agentic AI: connecting agents to metrics, logs, traces, events, change data, and service topology so they can detect, diagnose, and remediate production issues with minimal human intervention. You will define how agents reason over telemetry, which tools and runbooks they can call, the guardrails and approval gates that keep their actions safe, and the feedback loops that make them smarter after every incident. This role moves us from dashboards people have to watch to a self-healing production estate where AI observes, decides, and acts — and humans stay in control.

In this role, you will:

* Design and build autonomous AIOps agents (LLM-based and multi-agent) that run the full operational loop — observe, correlate, diagnose, decide, act, and verify — across incident triage, root-cause analysis, and auto-remediation
* Connect agents to the observability estate (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Tempo/Jaeger, APM, CMDB, change and deployment events) through well-defined tools/APIs and MCP servers, giving agents real-time, topology-aware context to reason over
* Turn observability signals into autonomous action: build event-driven triggers on SLO burn-rate, anomaly, and correlated alert patterns that launch agent workflows such as rollback, restart, scale-out, failover, traffic shift, config fix, or ticket enrichment
* Build the agent action layer: convert runbooks into machine-executable, idempotent actions (runbook-as-code), with pre-checks, blast-radius limits, dry-run modes, automatic rollback, and post-action health verification against SLIs
* Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls: risk-tiered autonomy levels, policy-as-code, approval gates for high-risk changes, full audit trails, and explainable reasoning for every decision an agent makes
* Apply AI to observability data: anomaly detection, forecasting, alert noise reduction, event correlation, and retrieval-augmented reasoning over past incidents, runbooks, and post-mortems to speed up RCA and cut MTTD/MTTR
* Build evaluation and observability for the agents themselves: trace agent reasoning and tool calls, measure accuracy, action success rate, false-action rate, latency, and cost; run replay/simulation and chaos tests before increasing autonomy in production
* Partner with SRE, platform, and application teams to onboard services to autonomous operations, set standards and reusable patterns, and coach engineers on using AI + observability to automate their own operational workflows

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:

* 10+ years overall experience with 5+ years in SRE, AIOps, observability, or platform engineering.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Your Team's Impact**  
  
We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** who is passionate about Generative AI, Agentic systems, and cloud-native API development. In this role, you will be a key contributor in designing, building, and deploying production-grade AI-powered applications and intelligent agent frameworks that transform the way our products and customers interact with data and automation.

You will collaborate closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Cloud Architects to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative solutions powered by cutting-edge GenAI technologies.
  
  
**What You'll Do**  
  
**GenAI & Agentic Development**

* Build and integrate **LLM-powered applications** using models from **OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta (LLaMA), Mistral** , or foundation models on cloud platforms
* Implement **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** pipelines, vector stores, and semantic search capabilities
* Develop **multi-agent orchestration systems** with defined tool use, memory management, and reasoning loops
* Evaluate, fine-tune, and optimize LLM behavior through **prompt engineering and chain-of-thought design**

**API Development & Backend Engineering**

* Build **high-performance, scalable RESTful APIs** and async microservices using **FastAPI** and Python
* Design clean, modular, and well-documented API contracts following **OpenAPI/Swagger** standards
* Implement **authentication, authorization, rate limiting** , and security best practices across APIs
Develop event-driven and streaming architectures to support real-time AI inference pipelines  

**Cloud & Platform Engineering**

* Deploy and manage AI workloads on **AWS** (SageMaker, Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, S3, ECS/EKS)

* Build **CI/CD pipelines** and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using tools like **Terraform, AWS CDK** , or similar
Ensure scalability, observability, and reliability through cloud-native monitoring and logging practices  

**Engineering Excellence**

* Write **clean, testable, production-ready Python code** following software engineering best practices
* Conduct **code reviews** and mentor junior engineers on GenAI patterns and best practices
* Contribute to architectural decisions, **technical roadmaps** , and engineering documentation
* Stay current with the **rapidly evolving GenAI ecosystem** and champion the adoption of emerging tools

**What We're Looking For**

* **5–7 years** of professional software engineering experience
* Hands-on Python development in production environments
* Experience with **GenAI technologies** including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, or prompt engineering
* Building and deploying APIs using **FastAPI** or similar async Python frameworks
* Experience working with **AWS** cloud services in a production environment
* Hands-on experience with **Databricks** for data/AI workloads

  

**Python & Frameworks**

* Expert-level **Python** (async programming, type hints, Pydantic, dependency injection)
* **FastAPI** – routing, middleware, background tasks, OpenAPI spec generation
* Experience with **SQLAlchemy, Alembic** , or async ORMs
* Unit/integration testing with **pytest, pytest-asyncio**

**GenAI & Agentic**

* Strong understanding of **LLM internals** , tokenization, context windows, and model behavior
* Experience with **LangChain / LangGraph / AutoGen / CrewAI** or similar agentic frameworks
* Familiarity with **vector databases** – Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, ChromaDB, or FAISS
* Knowledge of **RAG architectures** , chunking strategies, and embedding models
* Hands-on experience with **OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API, AWS Bedrock** , or Hugging Face models

**Cloud – AWS**

* **AWS Bedrock** – LLM model invocation and management
* **AWS Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS** – serverless and containerized deployments
* **S3, DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora** – data storage patterns
* **IAM, VPC, Secrets Manager** – security and access control
* Familiarity with **AWS CDK or CloudFormation**

**Databricks**

* Experience with **Databricks Workflows, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog**
* Familiarity with **MLflow** for experiment tracking and model registry
* Using Databricks for **AI/BI or LLM serving pipelines**

**General Engineering**

* **Docker & Kubernetes** – containerization and orchestration
* **Git** – branching strategies, PR workflows, GitOps
* **CI/CD** – GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar
* Understanding of **distributed systems** , event streaming (Kafka or AWS Kinesis), and microservice patterns

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Experience with **multi-modal AI** (vision + language models)
* Familiarity with **Azure OpenAI Service** or **Google Vertex AI**
* Exposure to **Terraform** or **Pulumi** for infrastructure automation

* Experience with **GraphQL APIs**
* Background in **data engineering** or MLOps pipelines

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field
Equivalent practical experience and demonstrable project portfolio will be considered.  

**What's In It For You**

  

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.

title: Sr. Consultant - Infrastructure Engineering
description:

* Coordinate the build, engineering, development, and production support of the API platform and self-service capabilities, including the API Management Hub and developer portals.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* 10–12 years of hands-on software, API, cloud, platform, or integration engineering experience delivering complex technical solutions independently.
* Strong development experience in TypeScript/Node.js, with working knowledge of Python.
* Practical experience working directly with AWS CDK and API or event-driven services, such as API Gateway, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, and Route 53.
* Hands-on experience with AWS API Gateway or Apigee; knowledge of both platforms is preferred.
* In-depth understanding of REST, HTTP, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning, error handling, rate limiting, backward compatibility, and API security through OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, API keys, TLS/mTLS, IAM/RBAC, and secrets management.
* Experience developing CI/CD pipelines and automated quality checks using GitHub Actions, testing frameworks, code scanning, and deployment automation.
* Experience in observability and production support, encompassing logs, metrics, alerts, tracing, incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and improving system reliability.

**Preferred Experience**

  

* Apigee proxy, product, developer application, policy, and administration experience.
* Developer portal, API cataloging, API linting, self-service automation, or developer-experience platform engineering.
* Event-driven architecture, container platforms such as Kubernetes/EKS, and application modernization patterns.
* Terraform, CloudFormation, or other solutions for Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience operating in Agile environments with structured change, incident, problem, and knowledge-management practices.

Through our product-driven Agile/Lean DevOps environment, we’ve fostered a culture of innovation and experimentation across our development teams. As a customer-focused organization, we work closely with our end users and product owners to understand and rapidly respond to emerging business needs.

Collaboration is embedded into everything we do – from the products we develop to the quality service we provide. We’re driven by the belief that diversity of thought, background, and perspective is critical to creating the best products and experiences for our customers.

At Principal, we value connecting on both a personal and professional level. Together, we’re imagining a more purpose-led future for financial services – and that starts with you. And we support our employees the same way we support our customers: with comprehensive, competitive benefit offerings crafted to protect their physical, financial, and social well-being. Check out our careers site to learn more about our purpose, values and benefits.

description:

title: Lead/Senior Security System Engineer - Network Cloud
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead/Senior Security System Engineer** to design, implement, and operate secure, compliant network segmentation between regional environments and Global networks, using a standardised control stack of Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Cloudflare for DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application protection. This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists
* Produce HLD/LLD, threat models, and control mappings aligned to internal standards and regional regulation to enable secure communication
* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* 6-15 years of overall IT experience, with a strong background in network security architecture and engineering
* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response
* Competency in automation and policy-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor REST APIs
* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

description:
