Apple's IS&T team builds the tools, platforms, and services that power the people who build Apple. Our Customer Systems group is reimagining how Apple engineers work through intelligent, autonomous systems - and we're looking for an Agentic AI Developer to help lead that effort.  
  
**Description**  
We are looking for a talented Agentic AI Developer to join Apple's IS&T Customer Systems team. In this role, you will design, build, and operate intelligent autonomous agent systems end-to-end - both client-side and server-side. You will architect agents that reason, plan, remember, and act reliably across long-running workflows, with deep attention to memory design, multi-agent orchestration, observability, and maintainability.  
  
This is a deeply technical engineering role with a high bar for production quality. You will own the full lifecycle of agentic systems: from agent architecture and memory design, to tool integration, observability, and safe deployment. While the primary focus is agent engineering, a solid understanding of the Java tech stack, React, and TypeScript is also important, as you will work across both server-side and client-side surfaces.  
You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and platform teams across Apple to bring AI capabilities into the developer tools our teams depend on every day.  
  
","responsibilities":"Design and implement multi-agent orchestration systems - including agent collaboration, task delegation, hand-offs, shared context management, role specialisation, and conflict resolution patterns  
Build agent memory architectures - episodic, semantic, and working memory - using vector stores (pgvector, Milvus) and hybrid retrieval strategies to enable agents to reason over past interactions and maintain state across sessions  
Develop tool and function-calling layers that expose internal APIs and services as agent-executable tools via MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or custom tool registries, with strong contracts and well-defined failure semantics  
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector stores and hybrid retrieval strategies to ground agent responses in authoritative internal knowledge  
Own the observability story for agentic systems - distributed tracing of agent runs, prompt and response capture, token and cost accounting, evaluation pipelines, replay and debugging, and regression detection using OpenTelemetry and LLM observability tooling  
Drive maintainability of agentic systems through versioning of prompts, tools, and agent graphs; deterministic test harnesses; evaluation suites; safe canary rollouts; and structured logging that makes non-deterministic behaviour debuggable  
Apply agent safety guardrails - input validation, prompt-injection defences, output schema contracts, and sandboxed code execution - to ensure systems are safe and reliable at production scale  
Architect and maintain server-side agent services using Java (Spring Boot, Spring AI) and client-side agent interfaces using React and TypeScript  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Experience implementing or consuming MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients  
Familiarity with model routing and fallback strategies across multiple LLM providers  
Reactive programming in Java - Project Reactor, WebFlux - for streaming LLM responses  
Python proficiency for agent prototyping and evaluation pipeline scripting  
Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms .  
Experience with agent sandboxing and safe code execution environments  
Awareness of fine-tuning, LoRA, and small-model distillation techniques for agent specialisation  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
4+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML systems, LLM integrations, or autonomous agent development  
Hands-on experience designing and implementing multi-agent orchestration systems and agent loop patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, or similar)  
Strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and TypeScript/React for building full-stack agentic applications  
Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: prompt engineering, context window management, function calling, structured outputs, and tool use  
Experience building RAG pipelines and working with vector databases .

**Responsibilities**

* Translate business and customer requirements into clear technical designs, identifying dependencies, edge cases, and implementation tradeoffs.
* Own the delivery of features and improvements across design, coding, testing, release, and production support.
* Develop and maintain services, APIs, database-backed applications, and user-facing capabilities with attention to reliability, security, performance, and scalability.

* Build quality into development through automated tests, code reviews, and validation of data integrity, backward compatibility, and performance.
* Collaborate with product management, UX, QA, and other engineering teams to clarify scope, resolve dependencies, and deliver useful customer outcomes.
* Contribute to technical decisions, explain tradeoffs, and identify opportunities to simplify architecture and reduce technical debt.
* Mentor engineers through constructive feedback, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

* Strong SQL and relational database skills, including data modeling, transactions, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
* Experience developing web applications or services, with an understanding of how browser, service, API, and database layers interact.

title: User Assistance Developer
description:
Oracle NetSuite is looking for an exceptional user assistance developer to create documentation for business software development tools. The ideal candidate has excellent writing and verbal communication skills, experience documenting business software, and a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced development environment. You will join a team with significant opportunities for career growth and development. You will work in an AI-assisted authoring environment and use sound editorial judgment to ensure that documentation is accurate, clear, complete, and aligned with product information and documentation standards.

  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and three or more years of experience as a user assistance developer, or equivalent transferable writing experience.
* Knowledge of technical communication techniques and standards.
* Excellent English-language, proofreading, editing, writing, and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Strong time-management and prioritization skills, including experience meeting tight deadlines and adapting to changing priorities.
* Experience working with report authoring tools.
* Experience with industry-standard financial and operational reports.
* Strong critical-thinking and editorial-review skills, including the ability to evaluate AI-assisted output for accuracy, completeness, bias, unsupported claims, and consistency with product information and documentation standards.
* Ability to validate information using authoritative sources and exercise sound judgment about when AI-assisted content requires additional research or subject-matter-expert review.
* Familiarity with prompt design, content-review workflows, and repeatable quality-assurance practices for AI-assisted documentation.
* Ability to learn and adapt to evolving authoring tools, content platforms, and documentation processes.
* Experience with, or strong interest in, writing developer documentation, including API documentation.
Knowledge of XML authoring tools.  

**Responsibilities:**

* Work closely with Product Management, Development, QA, and Technical Writing to successfully deliver assigned documentation projects.
* Proactively research product changes to determine the scope of edits for assigned documentation areas.
* Write new documentation based on use cases, user stories, feature requirements, specifications, information from developers and product managers, and hands-on use of the product.
* Use AI-assisted writing and development tools, such as ChatGPT, Codex, and Visual Studio Code, to support research, drafting, editing, analysis, and content maintenance.
* Validate AI-assisted output against authoritative product sources, including product behavior, requirements, specifications, and subject-matter-expert input.
* Apply strong editorial judgment to identify and correct hallucinations, unsupported claims, inconsistencies, ambiguity, outdated information, and deviations from documentation standards.
* Develop and refine effective prompts, reusable workflows, and quality checks that improve documentation quality and team efficiency.
* Maintain ownership of final content quality; AI-generated output is a starting point and does not replace writer review, product verification, or subject-matter-expert collaboration.
* Attend and actively contribute to writing and scrum team meetings.
* Partner with teams such as Support, Training, and Professional Services to understand and respond to customer documentation needs.
* Collaborate with other writers and cross-functional partners to establish responsible, scalable AI-assisted authoring practices.

title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Lead software architecture and modernization**

Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.

* **Stay deeply hands-on in code**

Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.

* **Design strong domain models and APIs**

Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.

* **Modernize application foundations**

Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.

* **Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability**

Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.

* **Improve data access and integration design**

Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.

* **Raise the bar for code quality and testing**

Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.

* **Create reusable engineering patterns**

Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.

* **Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution**

Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.

**WHAT THIS IS NOT**

* This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.
* This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering**

You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.

* **Credible hands-on implementation depth**

You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.

* **Service transformation and architecture judgment**

You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.

* **Production reliability and performance expertise**

You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.

* **Software design and refactoring depth**

You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.

* **Data and integration depth**

You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.

* **Strong testing and code-quality discipline**

You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.

* **Principal-level technical leadership**

You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.

* **An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering**

You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.

**BONUS POINTS**

* Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades.
* Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications.
* Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
* Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database-performance diagnosis, or tuning.
* Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* **Modernization advances without destabilizing the business**

Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity.

* **Critical software becomes easier to change**

Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior.

* **Architecture decisions become executable**

Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed.

* **Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle**

Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope.

* **AI expands engineering leverage**

AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.

**WHY THIS MATTERS**

ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.

This role connects long-term technical direction with hands-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, PCT Partner Connection Technology
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's last-mile delivery network relies on thousands of independent Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)- small businesses whose drivers deliver packages to customers every day. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to shape the technical direction of the platforms that support the full driver journey: from onboarding and qualification to communication, recognition, and the tools DSP owners use to manage and grow their teams.  
  
In this role, you will own the architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams. You will lead large, cross-team initiatives from concept to production, design scalable distributed systems, and drive operational excellence across a global, regulated domain spanning 20+ countries. You will go wherever the problem is—including partnering with teams across Amazon—to deliver the right solution for customers.  
  
This is a high-ownership role where you will balance hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing partner teams' roadmaps.  

* Scope: Technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and production services.
* Technologies: Java, TypeScript, React, and AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CDK).

  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the technical strategy and multi-year architecture across multiple teams and platforms; author the design documents and technical vision those teams build against.
* Lead large, ambiguous, cross-team projects from concept to production; decompose them into milestones other engineers can own and deliver.
* Design and build secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with robust authentication, authorization, and data-handling practices.
* Turn regulatory requirements from multiple countries into configurable, global solutions—partnering closely with product, compliance, and legal teams.
* Drive operational excellence through monitoring, root-cause analysis, deployment best practices, and continuous improvement of availability, latency, and cost.
* Mentor engineers across teams, contribute to hiring, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design reviews, documentation, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

  
A day in the life  
You will work across teams and systems—connecting the dots and helping move things forward. That means design reviews, hands-on coding, debugging production issues, and pairing on APIs that power real-world driver workflows. You will collaborate with product, compliance, legal, and engineering partners across multiple countries. Beyond the roadmap, you might interview candidates, contribute fixes across codebases, support on-call, or run workshops to help fellow engineers grow.  
  
About the team  
Partner Connection Technology builds the systems connecting Amazon with its Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)—independent small businesses whose drivers deliver Amazon packages. We manage the full driver lifecycle: onboarding, identity checks, vehicle/route qualifications, communication across email, apps, and messaging, and recognition experiences like customer-to-driver thank-yous. Serving DSP owners, drivers, and Amazon support teams in 20+ countries, our three engineering teams focus on absorbing complexity so small business owners don't have to—building configurable global solutions, not one-off fixes. The domain is regulated and fast-moving, with real architecture challenges and room to shape it.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

description:

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**The Opportunity**

Keyloop is in the middle of an AI-enabled transformation, driven by the AI Empowered Programme — a board-mandated effort to lift AI maturity across our ~80 Product & Engineering teams. Two teams sit at the heart of it: Keystone, which builds the underlying AI capability and technical pathways, and Impost, which enables teams to adopt that capability hands-on.

We're looking for an highly motivated AI Enablement Engineer to join Impost and help our engineering teams put Keystone's AI capability to real, effective use. The primary mode of engagement is through a team's AI Champion — coaching, mentoring, or pairing with them to drive sustained, long-term change. You'll also work directly with teams for shorter periods to help resolve specific technical challenges, or gain the kind of deep, first-hand insight that's only visible from inside a team's day-to-day work and feeding it back into the programme.

  

This is a hands-on software engineering role, not an "engineer who used to code." You'll sit on the frontline of AI-driven development lifecycle innovation at Keyloop — as part of the Impost team, you'll be the first adopter team for Keystone's experimental new solutions, taking ownership of real internal systems as genuine test grounds. You'll contribute directly to Keystone's solutions — sometimes through early feedback on what's rough or missing, sometimes through hands-on contribution and pull requests.  
  
Keyloop itself is a dual-speed technology organization: a large, successful DMS heritage business running on established platforms built up over decades, alongside Fusion — a modern, cloud-native Automotive Retail Platform built on AWS, event-driven domain services. You won't need to master every technology across that estate yourself — each team owns its own stack, and that expertise stays with them. Your focus is AI: helping teams leverage Claude Code, skills, agents, and Keystone's recommended solutions effectively, whatever stack they happen to be working in.

### **What You'll Bring**

Must-have:

* Fluency in AI assisted and agentic software development

* Strong, hands-on engineering background with genuine credibility pairing and mentoring other engineers on real technical problems.

* Comfort mastering new, evolving AI capability early — often ahead of formal documentation or a fixed playbook.

* A genuine interest in, and demonstrated ability to have a strong positive impact on the growth of others — through pairing, mentoring, coaching, or developer advocacy. This role is built around lifting other people up, not working heads-down in isolation; if that's not energizing to you, this isn't the right fit.

* Ability to read a team's context and choose the right mode of engagement (direct vs. through a Champion) rather than applying one approach everywhere.

* Experience working effectively across a distributed, multi-location engineering organisation.

* Based in, or willing to work from, Oulu, Finland or Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

### **What You'll Do**

* Direct & Champion-Mediated Enablement: Provide hands-on technical support, training, and mentoring on Keystone's AI capability — working directly with a team or through its AI Champion, depending on context and champion maturity.

* Champion Development: Build the technical capability of AI Champions so they can scale enablement within their own teams, multiplying Impost's reach beyond what a small central team could do alone.

* Early Adoption ("Dogfooding"): Take ownership of real internal systems — starting with the OEM TTV Dashboard — as the test ground for Keystone's experimental new solutions before they reach any other team. Build with them, break them, and feed what you learn directly back into Keystone's own development, through early feedback or, where appropriate, hands-on contribution and pull requests.

* Field Feedback & Cross-Pollination: Surface what works and what doesn't from real engagements; escalate unresolved technical friction to Keystone; spot effective practices in one team and help spread them to others.

* Triage: Recognise when a team's blocker isn't a technical/AI problem, and surface it to the Enablement Workstream for routing — rather than trying to solve it yourself.

* Community & Advocacy: Stay active in relevant AI communities of practice and forums as a natural part of the job; contribute technical content, demos, or talks as capacity allows.

* AI Landscape & Continuous Learning  
  Proactively track developments in AI tooling and practices internally and externally. Bring relevant insights into the organisation and translate them into actionable enablement opportunities before they are asked for.

### **Nice-to-have:**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

### **Nice to Have**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

title: Software Engineering Manager-Insights Application
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Lead and coach a team across backend, frontend, cloud, DevOps, production support, and release validation responsibilities.

* Strengthen application reliability across multi-tenant architecture, customer access models, background processing, messaging, integrations, and data platform dependencies.

**WHAT YOU BRING**
------------------

* Recent hands-on experience designing, building, reviewing, and operating production web applications; this is not a people-only management role.
* Strong technical background in .NET / C#, API development, React or comparable SPA frameworks, and modern web application architecture.
* Experience leading engineering teams through delivery planning, technical decision-making, production support, and release execution.
* Working knowledge of the current Azure production stack (App Service, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Entra ID, or comparable services), plus hands-on AWS experience to lead and execute the platform migration to AWS.

* Practical experience with AI-assisted software development, including Cursor (or a closely comparable AI coding assistant / IDE), and the ability to apply it to design, coding, code review, testing, documentation, and incident analysis while keeping humans accountable for production quality.
* Experience with CI/CD, release engineering, environment management, and migration or improvement of build and deployment workflows.
* Ability to operate in a production environment, including incident management, root-cause analysis, observability, service health, and reliability improvement.
* Strong collaboration with Product or Product Owner functions, including backlog shaping, acceptance criteria, tradeoff decisions, and roadmap execution.
Ability to coach engineers at all experience levels, create accountability, and balance hands-on technical guidance with people leadership.  

**IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**
-----------------------

* Experience with Power BI, embedded analytics, or other BI / reporting platforms.
* Deeper AWS architecture experience (landing zones, networking, identity, cost management, or large-scale Azure-to-AWS application migration).
* Experience establishing team standards for AI-assisted development with Cursor, including prompt/review practices, security guardrails, and measuring productivity impact.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture and hierarchical customer access models.
* Experience modernizing a large, long-lived frontend application, including framework and build-toolchain upgrades.
* Familiarity with warehousing, ETL, data engineering partnerships, or data platform adjacency.
* Experience with payments, billing integrations, SSO, identity federation, SOC 2, vertical SaaS, fitness, wellness, or multi-product platform environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------

* Clear ownership, stable delivery rhythms, and strong accountability across application development and production support.
* The current application is better understood, better documented, more reliable, and easier for the team to operate and enhance.
* A practical next-generation application direction is defined, with clear modernization priorities, an Azure-to-AWS migration sequence, and team adoption of AI-assisted engineering (including Cursor).
* Releases are more predictable, incidents are managed with discipline, and quality validation improves across environments.
* Engineers on the team receive strong technical guidance, coaching, prioritization, and support for growth.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

title: Software Development Engineer, Ship With Amazon
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes.  
  
We have built a highly respected software engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. These are large-scale distributed systems handling millions of packages being shipped through the Amazon logistics network.  
  
You will be working with senior SDEs and principals to solve problems of scale, improve existing services & build new ones, and work on deep and complex algorithms to improve the experience of our customers globally while optimizing network operations.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: PC- 1523 Senior Zoho CRM Developer
description:
**Role Overview**

The **Zoho CRM Developer** is a highly skilled technical specialist responsible for the design, development, configuration, integration, and ongoing optimisation of Zoho CRM and associated Zoho ecosystem platforms. The role focuses on delivering scalable, secure, and intelligent customer relationship management solutions that streamline business processes, improve customer engagement, and enable data-driven decision-making.

This role requires deep expertise in **Zoho CRM configuration, Deluge scripting, custom functions, REST APIs, webhooks, workflow automation, custom widgets, Zoho AI capabilities, enterprise integrations, HTML, CSS, SQL, Node.js, and JavaScript**. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, solution architects, business analysts, and engineering teams to build innovative CRM solutions aligned with business objectives.

**What will you do?**

* Design, configure, and customise Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk to deliver customer service platforms with AI-powered capabilities.
* Develop advanced Deluge scripts and custom functions to extend both platforms, automate complex business logic, and integrate with third-party systems.
* Build custom widgets and UI components using Deluge to enhance sales dashboards, customer portals, and support agent interfaces.
* Create sophisticated automation workflows combining Deluge scripting with pipeline management and customer support operations.
* Implement AI-powered capabilities using Zoho's AI offerings and external AI services.
* Manage data migrations, synchronisation, cleansing, deduplication, and governance activities.
* Integrate agent-based AI architectures and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers with Deluge-powered custom logic for intelligent automation.
* Manage seamless data synchronisation and integrations between Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, and external systems using Deluge APIs, webhooks, and custom connectors.

Collaborate with Sales, Support, Operations, and Product teams to translate business requirements into integrated, intelligent Zoho solutions. **Key Responsibilities**

Deluge Scripting & Custom Development

* Develop advanced Deluge scripts for custom automation, business logic, and complex workflows across Zoho CRM and Desk.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-documented Deluge code following best practices and coding standards.
* Build custom functions for lead scoring, deal management, ticket processing, routing logic, data transformations.
* Implement error handling, logging, and performance optimisation in Deluge scripts for production reliability.

Custom Widget & UI Development

* Design and develop custom widgets using Zoho Widget Framework and Deluge to enhance CRM and Desk interfaces.
* Build interactive sales dashboards, agent consoles, customer portals, and management views with custom widgets.
* Integrate widgets with AI models and data services to display AI-powered insights, recommendations, and analytics.
* Customise page layouts, views, and configurations across both platforms to align with business workflows.
* Design CRM Canvas experiences, widgets, kiosks, and forms that create efficient user journeys across CRM and support processes.

Zoho CRM Configuration

* Configure and manage Zoho CRM modules, fields, layouts, workflows, approvals, blueprints, assignment rules, notifications, views, page layouts, and pipeline workflows.
* Implement sales automation, lead management, deal tracking, and forecasting capabilities aligned with strategy.
* Design and optimise Zoho CRM dashboards and reports for team performance monitoring and pipeline visibility.
* Develop reports, dashboards, KPIs, analytical data models, and where required, SQL queries to support operational visibility and business decision-making.

Zoho Desk Configuration & Support Operations

* Configure and manage Zoho Desk modules, channels, workflows, and SLAs for multi-channel support operations.
* Implement email, chat, phone, social media, and portal integrations for seamless customer service.
* Design and optimise Zoho Desk dashboards for support team performance monitoring and KPI tracking.

AI-Powered Sales & Customer Service

* Implement AI capabilities in Zoho CRM: AI lead scoring, sales predictions, opportunity recommendations, and AI-assisted deal closure.
* Deploy AI features in Zoho Desk: AI-powered ticket routing, categorisation, sentiment analysis, and agent recommendations.
* Build AI chatbots and virtual agents for lead qualification, customer support, and self-service using Deluge logic.
* Explore and implement agent-based AI architectures, MCP servers, and AI orchestration frameworks across both platforms.

Advanced Automation & Workflows

* Design and implement sophisticated automation rules, workflows, and SLAs using Deluge for complex sales and support logic.
* Build intelligent escalation logic, conditional routing, and AI-triggered workflows across CRM and Desk.
* Optimise Deluge scripts and workflows for performance, maintainability, and reliability.

CRM & Desk Integration & Data Synchronisation

* Design and implement seamless bi-directional synchronisation between Zoho CRM and Desk for unified customer view.
* Develop custom APIs, webhooks, and Deluge connectors to integrate with third-party systems and AI services.
* Connect Zoho applications with operational systems and external services, including API mapping, authentication, monitoring, and error handling.
* Ensure reliable, secure integrations with proper authentication, error handling, and performance optimisation.
* Maintain solution designs, configuration records, integration specifications, data dictionaries, and support runbooks to enable reliable delivery and operational support.

Data Management

* Manage data quality, integrity, and migrations across Zoho CRM and Desk using Deluge data processing and ETL scripts.
* Perform data mapping, transformation, imports, record updates, deduplication, validation, profiling, reconciliation, cleansing, duplicate identification, and ongoing data quality rule implementation.
* Build data pipelines to feed AI models with quality sales and support data for insights, predictions, and recommendations.
Monitor Zoho Desk and CRM performance, Deluge execution times, widget rendering, and system reliability.  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience with Zoho CRM and/or Zoho Desk, including configuration, customisation, and implementation.
* Expert-level proficiency in Deluge scripting language with hands-on experience building complex business logic.
* Strong experience designing and developing custom widgets using Zoho Widget Framework and Deluge.
* Deep expertise in Zoho CRM configuration: modules, fields, workflows, automations, sales pipelines, and dashboards.
* Deep expertise in Zoho Desk configuration: automation rules, workflows, SLAs, multi-channel setup, and ticketing.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho AI capabilities: AI lead scoring, sales predictions, AI routing, sentiment analysis, chatbots.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, Deluge API calls, and system integration patterns.
* Proficiency with databases (SQL), data transformation, ETL concepts, and Deluge data processing functions.
* Experience with different integration platforms and building custom connectors.
* Knowledge of customer service operations, and support metrics (response time, SLA management).
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, code quality focus, and ability to work independently and in teams.
* Advanced Deluge expertise including meta-programming, reflection, and advanced data structure manipulation.
* Experience building reusable widget libraries and contributing to Zoho marketplace widget ecosystems.
* Hands-on experience implementing and optimising Zoho AI features across both CRM and Desk platforms.
* Experience with agent-based AI architectures, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, and Deluge-based AI orchestration.
* Experience with Zoho Creator or other Zoho low-code platforms for additional integration capabilities.
* Zoho certifications or equivalent credentials.
* Experience with HTML, CSS, SQL, Node.js, and JavaScript for advanced UI customisation, widget enhancement, integrations, and analytical query support.
* Familiarity with CRM best practices, sales operations, and omnichannel customer experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Integrated CRM and Desk platforms deliver unified sales and customer service experiences with seamless data flow.
* Deluge-powered automation and custom widgets enhance sales dashboards and support interfaces with rich, intuitive UX.
* AI capabilities drive measurable improvements: higher sales conversion, improved forecast accuracy, better CSAT, reduced response times.
* Complex business logic in clean, maintainable Deluge code enables sales and support teams to focus on value-added activities.
* Integration ecosystem is mature, performant, and enables seamless data flow via Deluge connectors and APIs.
* AI-powered lead qualification, deal recommendations, customer support automation, and self-service reduce manual effort.
* You contribute to a high-performing technical team through knowledge sharing on Deluge best practices, widget development, and AI integration.

Experience with AngularJS and/or modern Angular, including evolving legacy UI architectures into modular, maintainable systems

Experience with Windows Services, WebJobs, and asynchronous processing patterns supporting enterprise workloads

* Improves system reliability through better observability and engineering practices

**Preferred / Distinguishing Factors**

* Contributions to engineering excellence, platform thinking, or AI adoption initiatives

title: Builder Developer III
description:
**The Builder-3 Profile**

You are a systems engineer for non-deterministic systems. You are comfortable saying "no, not yet" to a working demo, and you can say exactly what would change your mind.

**1. Core DNA (shared foundation, at lead altitude)**

* **AI-Native Workflow.** You don't just use AI tools fast — you set the squad's bar for what "fast and safe" looks like, and you remove the bottleneck when someone hits one.
* **Agentic Architecture.** You still build end-to-end agents yourself, and you do. But your leverage comes from designing the state management, tool interfaces and failure semantics that everyone else builds inside.
* **Legacy-to-Modern Sequencing.** You decide *which* legacy modules get modernized first, based on blast radius, data gravity and how cheaply success can be measured — not on which one looks most fun.
* **Measured Reliability.** You define what "reliable enough" means for each workflow: acceptance thresholds, regression suites, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, rollback paths. You know that "100% accurate" is a marketing phrase, and that the engineering version is a measured error rate with a defined containment strategy.

**2. The Three Things You Own**

**a) The Guardrail Layer** Input and output validation, tool-permission scoping, financial and PII data handling, sandboxed execution, human approval gates on irreversible actions, kill switches, blast-radius containment. You assume the agent will eventually do the wrong thing, and you design so that it costs us a log line instead of a General Ledger.

**b) The Eval Framework** Golden datasets built from real ERP edge cases. Offline evals in CI as a merge gate, online evals in production. LLM-as-judge calibrated against human labels — and you know when that calibration has drifted. Regression detection when a model version, prompt or retrieval index changes underneath you. You move the squad from "prompt vibes" to a number that can fail a build.

**c) The Cost & Performance Envelope** Model routing, caching, context budgeting, latency budgets. You track token cost per *completed business transaction*, not per call, and you can tell the CFO why a workflow costs what it costs and where the next 40% comes from.

**3. Elective Depth (be deep in one, fluent in all six)**

* **Agentic Architect (Systems)** — state management and tool-calling interfaces for long-running business processes across complex ERP schemas.
* **UX/Interaction (Product)** — generative UIs and browser-use agents; designing where the human stays in the loop and where they don't need to be.
* **Data & Context (Data)** — RAG and knowledge-graph architecture: vector stores, chunking strategy, retrieval evals, and the relationship between a Purchase Order and a GL entry.
* **Reliability & Eval (QA)** — programmatic prompt optimization (DSPy), red-teaming agents, adversarial testing of financial logic.
* **Infra & Agent-Ops (DevOps)** — the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the "thoughts" of the AI; deployment and rollback of prompts and models as versioned artifacts.
* **Domain Logic Translation (Business)** — turning 50 pages of accounting regulation into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.

**What You'll Actually Do**

* **Set the definition of shippable.** Write the standard for when an agent can touch production data, and enforce it in code, not in a wiki page.
* **Build the eval harness** and wire it into CI as a gate that can and does block merges.
* **Design the guardrails** around regulated and financial logic, including the human approval and rollback paths.
* **Run design reviews.** Kill bad agent architectures in week one instead of month four. Be specific about why.
* **Own agent incidents.** Pull the traces, find the root cause, and add the eval that makes that failure impossible to reintroduce.
* **Make build-vs-buy calls** on frameworks, vendors and models — and revisit them when the ground shifts, which it will.
* **Grow Builder 1s and 2s** through code review, design review and pairing. Not through ceremony.

**What Good Looks Like**

*(Targets to be agreed with the hiring manager — these are illustrative, not fixed.)*

* **90 days:** Eval harness running in CI on at least two live agentic workflows, with a published reliability baseline. A written, enforced guardrail standard.
* **6 months:** Every production agent has a regression suite, a cost-per-transaction number, and a rollback path. Agent-related incidents are down and post-incident evals exist for each.
* **12 months:** The squad ships agentic modules on a predictable cadence without you in the critical path of each one.

**The Stack**

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, pgvector/Qdrant, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry — plus the orchestration layer you'll live in: eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent), policy and guardrail tooling, model routing and caching. And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.

**Who You Are**

* **You've been burned.** You have shipped an agentic system to real users, watched it fail in a way you didn't predict, and changed your architecture because of it. This is the single strongest signal for this level.
* **Rigor over hype.** You love new models and you still ask for the eval numbers first. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data.
* **Agent-first thinker.** You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* **The manual-task hater.** If you do a task twice, you've already started drafting the workflow that kills it.
* **Technically fearless.** A 500-table undocumented legacy schema is a puzzle, not a threat.
* **A multiplier.** Your best week is one where the squad shipped three things and you wrote one design doc and two brutal, useful reviews.

**Why Join Us**

* **The Final Boss of complexity.** ERPs are the hardest problem in software for AI. Automate a General Ledger and you've mastered the game.
* **Agentic autonomy.** We don't do tickets. We do missions. You choose the models, frameworks and architectures you believe will win.
* **No red tape.** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a "Does It Work?" policy. Note that *you* are the person who defines what "works" means.
* **The Builder Tribe.** You will not be the only AI person in the room. You'll lead a squad of people as obsessed with moving 10x faster as you are.

title: Builder Developer II
description:
**Job Description**

**The Builder-2 (Dev) Profile**

You are a full-stack agent engineer. You can take a complex business requirement and build the multi-step AI workflow that solves it, end to end, without someone breaking it down for you first.

**1. Core DNA**

* **AI-Native Workflow.** You use AI to accelerate development, testing and documentation as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place.
* **Agentic Implementation.** You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and long-running business logic.
* **Legacy-to-Modern Bridge.** You treat 20-year-old systems as puzzles for AI-driven modernization, not as someone else’s problem.
* **Evidence Over Confidence.** You don’t ship an agent because the demo went well. You ship it because you can show what it does on the edge cases — and you know your own error rate rather than claiming there isn’t one.

**2. What You Own**

**Your agent.** Design, build, debug, deploy, and keep running. Including the unglamorous parts: retries, state recovery, timeouts, what happens when the model is down.

**The evidence it works.** Before you refactor an undocumented module, you capture what it currently does — characterization tests, real inputs, real outputs. After, you show the behaviour matches. Your Builder 3 sets the standard; meeting it is your job, not theirs.

**Your blast radius.** You know exactly what your agent is permitted to touch, and you build so a wrong answer costs a review comment rather than a bad ledger entry.

**3. Your Elective Specialty (lean into one)**

* **The Agentic Architect (Systems)** — you don’t just build APIs, you build tool-calling interfaces and state management for agentic graphs that survive long-running business processes.
* **The UX/Interaction Builder (Product)** — the chatbox is just the beginning. You build generative UIs and browser-use agents that navigate existing portals to get work done.
* **The Data & Context Engineer (Data)** — master of the RAG pipeline. Vector stores, chunking strategy, and knowledge graphs that teach the AI how a Purchase Order relates to a GL entry.
* **The Reliability & Eval Engineer (QA)** — you move the team from prompt vibes to prompt engineering. DSPy for programmatic optimization, red-teaming agents to pressure-test financial logic.
* **The Infra & Agent-Ops Builder (DevOps)** — you build the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the thoughts of the AI.
* **The Domain Logic Translator (Business)** — you take 50 pages of accounting regulation and turn it into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* **Build execution agents.** Move beyond RAG into action — agents that navigate an ERP schema, find a data discrepancy and propose the fix.
* **Automate the untestable.** Wrap legacy business logic in modern tests and documentation using AI, starting with the modules everyone else has avoided.
* **Prove parity.** Capture what the old code does before you replace it, and show the new path matches — on the boring cases and the fiscal-calendar, multi-currency, partial-shipment ones.
* **Prompt engineering and evals.** Use frameworks like DSPy to move from vibes-based prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions.
* **Rapid prototyping.** Turn a “what if” into a working AI-driven feature in days, not months.
* **Fix your own agents in production.** Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again.

**What Good Looks Like**

*(Illustrative — real targets agreed with the hiring manager.)*

* **30 days:** Shipped your first agentic workflow into a real environment, however small.
* **90 days:** Owning a legacy module end to end — parity evidence, tests, deployment — with minimal supervision.
* **6 months:** Other Builders are reusing patterns you built. You’re the person people ask about one thing in particular.

**The Stack**

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, agentic coding tools, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Playwright, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent). And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.

**Who You Are**

* **You’ve shipped one.** You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work — not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did.
* **The early adopter.** You were using GPT-3 before it was cool and had a local model running the week it leaked. More time on r/LocalLLaMA, GitHub Trending and AI Twitter than on LinkedIn.
* **Agent-first thinker.** You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* **The manual-task hater.** You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you’ve already started drafting the automation.
* **Technically fearless.** A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn’t complexity, it’s a puzzle about to get solved. You aren’t intimidated by spaghetti code — you’re the one who brings the sauce.
* **Rigor over hype.** You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data.

**Why Join Us**

* **The Final Boss of complexity.** ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. Automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain and you’ve mastered the hardest problem in software.
* **Agentic autonomy.** We don’t do tickets. We do missions. You’ll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win.
* **No red tape.** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a “Does It Work?” policy.
* **The Builder Tribe.** You won’t be the only AI person in the room. You’ll be part of a small squad of people equally obsessed with moving faster, where your automation hacks are your biggest contribution rather than a hidden side project.

title: Software Development Engineer, WWRR Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.

We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.

title: Software Development Manager, DSP Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.  
  
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights.  
  
This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
* You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
* You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
* Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
* Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
* Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
* Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
* Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
* Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language
* Define and track success metrics including signal to surface latency, configuration deployment time, incident context assembly time, and signal launch velocity
* Operate with two core principles: Zero Gravity (collapse dependencies into a single orchestrator) and Zero Friction (remove barriers between insight and action)

  
A day in the life  
You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. You will regularly engage with stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, accountability, and legal teams to understand their pain points and translate those into platform capabilities. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands on technical leadership, ensuring your team delivers operationally stable, scalable solutions across multiple countries.  
  
About the team  
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.  
  
We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of engineering experience
* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 3+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Responsibilities:

* **Power Apps Development**: Design and implement Power Apps solutions to automate business processes and improve operational efficiency, integrating them with backend systems where necessary.

Skilled in creating seamless workflows to automate data refreshes, trigger notifications, and integrate external systems, ensuring real-time data accessibility and enhanced reporting
* **SQL Server Expertise**: Utilize SQL Server for database design, querying, and optimization. Ensure efficient data extraction and transformation for reporting purposes.

* **Stakeholder Management**: Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating them into actionable BI solutions. Regularly update stakeholders on project progress and outcomes.
* **Individual Contributor**: While taking on a leadership role, the candidate will also be expected to work independently, particularly on complex reporting tasks or when tight deadlines arise.
* **Data Integration & ETL**: Integrate data from various sources (including but not limited to SQL Server, cloud-based systems, and third-party APIs) and ensure smooth ETL processes for data accuracy and consistency.
* **Performance Tuning & Optimization**: Ensure that Power BI reports and dashboards are optimized for performance, utilizing best practices for large datasets and complex queries.
* **Documentation & Best Practices**: Create and maintain technical documentation, ensuring adherence to best practices in data governance, report design, and security standards.

  
Qualifications:

* **Power BI**: Strong experience in developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including advanced features like Power Query, DAX, and Power BI Service.
* **Power Apps**: Proficiency in building and managing Power Apps applications to automate workflows and improve user productivity.
* **Power Automate**: Proficient in designing flows that enhance the efficiency of Power BI reports and dashboards by automating data ingestion, data transformation, and alert management, enabling a more responsive and dynamic business intelligence solution.

* **Stakeholder Management**: Strong communication skills to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and manage client expectations.

* **Project Management**: Ability to handle multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and prioritize effectively while working both independently and in a team setting.

**Must have skills**:

* 8+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying Power BI solutions.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI desktop, Power Query, DAX, Power BI Service, and Power BI Report Server.
* Strong experience in working with large datasets and optimizing Power BI reports for performance.
* Expertise in SQL for complex data querying, transformations, and integrations with Power BI.
* Integrate Power BI with other systems and data sources (SQL, SharePoint, Excel, etc.) for seamless data flow.
* Design and develop custom Power Apps to automate business processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Create, manage, and optimize automated workflows using Power Automate to streamline tasks and integrate systems.

* Experience with Power BI Embedded for integrating BI reports into third-party applications or web portals.
* Familiarity with PowerShell scripting for Power BI administration, report deployment, and automation tasks.
* Experience with data warehousing concepts and solutions, including ETL processes and tools like Azure Data Factory or SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).

* Experience with Agile project management methodologies and working in cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
