title: Tech Developer – D&C Project Controls Program
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Developer – D&C Project Controls Program
  
Position Overview
  
The Project Intake Developer serves as the technical backbone of the Design & Construction (D&C) Project Controls Program's intake platform. This role is responsible for the end-to-end management of the Project Intake product — from maintaining platform stability and resolving customer-reported issues, to designing and delivering feature upgrades that enhance the user experience. The Developer operates at the intersection of software engineering, customer support, and product delivery, ensuring the intake platform remains reliable, performant, and aligned with evolving business needs across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions.
  
A core function of this role is translating customer feedback and operational pain points into actionable technical improvements, managing the product backlog, and communicating platform changes clearly and proactively to stakeholders. The Developer is expected to own the full product lifecycle — triaging defects, shipping enhancements, maintaining data integrity, and building trust with customers through transparent, timely communication about what's changing and why.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Customer Complaint Management & Issue Resolution
  
Serve as the technical point of contact for customer-reported issues, bugs, and service disruptions related to the Project Intake platform.
  
Triage, diagnose, and resolve platform defects — performing root-cause analysis and implementing permanent fixes to prevent recurrence.
  
Maintain a structured issue-tracking workflow (using SIM, or equivalent ticketing systems) to ensure all customer complaints are logged, prioritized, and resolved within defined SLAs.
  
Analyze complaint trends and recurring issues to identify systemic platform weaknesses and inform the product improvement roadmap.
  
Communicate resolution timelines and status updates to affected customers and stakeholders in a clear, empathetic, and professional manner.
  
  
Feature Upgrades & Product Development
  
Own the product backlog for the Project Intake platform — gathering requirements from customers, intake coordinators, analysts, and leadership to prioritize feature enhancements.
  
Design, develop, test, and deploy new features and functionality that improve intake workflows, data capture accuracy, and user experience.
  
Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms (e.g., Amazon Q, Amazon Quick Suite, internal ML/NLP solutions) to build intelligent automation into the intake product — including smart routing, auto-classification, and predictive triage capabilities.
  
Collaborate with UX/UI stakeholders to ensure feature designs are intuitive, accessible, and aligned with customer needs.
  
Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) with key stakeholders and iterate based on feedback before production release.
  
Develop and maintain APIs and integrations that connect the intake platform with downstream project execution systems, reporting tools, and data warehouses.
  
  
Platform Maintenance & Reliability
  
Ensure the ongoing stability, performance, and security of the Project Intake platform through proactive monitoring, patching, and infrastructure management.
  
Manage platform deployments, version control, and release cycles — maintaining a clean CI/CD pipeline and minimizing downtime during updates.
  
Conduct regular code reviews, technical debt assessments, and performance optimization to maintain platform health and scalability.
  
Maintain comprehensive technical documentation — including system architecture diagrams, runbooks, deployment procedures, and configuration guides.
  
Implement and monitor data validation rules, error handling, and logging to ensure data integrity across the intake pipeline.
  
Establish and maintain disaster recovery procedures and backup protocols for platform data and configurations.
  
  
Change Communication & Customer Engagement
  
Develop and execute a structured change communication plan for all platform updates — including feature releases, bug fixes, scheduled maintenance, and deprecations.
  
Create clear, customer-facing release notes, knowledge base articles, FAQs, and training materials that explain what's changing, why, and how it impacts users.
  
  
Dashboard Development & Data Visualization
  
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards (using QuickSight, or similar tools) that provide real-time visibility into intake KPIs — including time-to-assignment, SLA adherence, request completion rates, routing accuracy, and workload distribution across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions.
  
Develop self-service reporting solutions that enable stakeholders and leadership to explore intake data independently.
  
Create executive-ready visualizations and narratives that translate complex data into clear, compelling stories for D&C Project Controls leadership.
  
Continuously iterate on dashboard design based on user feedback, evolving business needs, and new data sources.
  
  
Data Analysis, Improvement & Insight Generation
  
Analyze intake data across project types (new construction, renovations, and small-scale projects) to identify volume trends, bottlenecks, cycle-time variances, and resource allocation patterns.
  
Proactively assess data quality and integrity — identifying inconsistencies, gaps, duplicates, and classification errors within intake datasets and recommending corrective actions.
  
Develop and implement data cleansing, standardization, and enrichment processes to improve the reliability and usability of intake data over time.
  
  
AI Tool Utilization & Automation
  
Leverage in-house AI tools and platforms (e.g., Amazon Q, Amazon Quick Suite, internal ML/NLP solutions) to automate request triage, classification, and preliminary routing recommendations.
  
Monitor and validate AI-triage output quality — flagging misclassifications, calibrating confidence thresholds, and providing feedback loops to improve model accuracy over time.
  
Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for document review, scope extraction, and compliance gap identification within intake submissions.
  
  
Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement
  
Use data analysis, customer feedback, and AI insights to identify inefficiencies in intake workflows and propose evidence-based improvements.
  
Develop and refine scoring models, routing criteria, and prioritization frameworks grounded in historical performance data.
  
Contribute to the establishment and monitoring of service level agreements (SLAs) and performance benchmarks.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
Experience
  
4–6 years of experience in software development, platform engineering, or technical product management within corporate real estate, facilities management, design & construction, or professional services environments.
  
Proven track record of managing customer complaints and translating user feedback into product improvements.
  
Experience designing and building dashboards and performance reports that drive operational decision-making.
  
Proven track record of improving data quality and using data to drive process improvement and operational efficiency.
  
knowledge of Amazon BI tools, e.g. Quick Suite, internal NLP/ML platforms) strongly preferred.
  
  
Skills & Competencies
  
Software Development & Platform Management — Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java) with experience in web application development, API design, and database management (SQL, NoSQL).
  
Customer Issue Management — Experience using ticketing systems (SIM, Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent) to triage, track, and resolve customer-reported issues within SLA targets.
  
Dashboard & Visualization Skills — Proven ability to design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Ability to tell a data story through compelling visualizations.
  
AI & Automation Proficiency (Preferred) — Hands-on experience with AI-enabled tools, generative AI platforms, or machine learning applications in a business context. Familiarity with in-house AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, Amazon Quick Suite, internal NLP/ML platforms) strongly preferred.
  
  
Personal Attributes
  
Customer-first mindset with a genuine commitment to resolving issues quickly and communicating transparently with stakeholders.
  
Ownership mentality — treats the platform as their product, proactively identifying and fixing problems before they escalate.
  
Adaptable and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with an evolving product and technology landscape.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Software Development Manager, GREF Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.  
  
We are seeking a Software Development Manager (SDM) to lead the development of new services that power the end-to-end travel and expense experience for Amazonians worldwide. You will build and ship solutions across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules — integrating AI capabilities such as intelligent policy guidance, automated expense categorization, and GenAI-driven workflows into production systems that must work reliably across 64 countries, multiple currencies, and diverse regulatory environments.  
  
You will partner closely with Product Managers, Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Front-End Engineers (FEEs), and Applied Scientists to translate the platform vision into scalable, high-quality services that simplify how employees travel, host events, and manage expenses.  
  
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience building and leading teams of software engineers, front-end engineers, and technical program managers, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-level systems at scale. They will be a strategic thinker who hires and develops exceptional talent, sets clear goals tied to organizational impact, and independently manages both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities — fostering a high-performance, team-oriented culture.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Software Development Manager, you will:  
  
Technical Leadership & Innovation Shape architectural decisions for next-generation Travel & Expense systems and services that process sensitive financial and employee data across 64 countries Drive adoption of AI technologies — including agentic AI, LLMs, and ML-powered pattern detection — to transform manual travel and expense operations into intelligent, autonomous workflows Design scalable, secure systems with enterprise-grade controls, observability, and auditability built in from day one Build flexible integration patterns that bridge modern and legacy transactional systems across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules Partner with AWS teams to evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities and primitives.  
  
Team Leadership Lead a high-performing engineering team building solutions that support Travel & Events operations and transactions at massive scale Hire, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent across backend, frontend, and program management disciplines Set clear goals tied to measurable organizational impact and independently manage both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities Foster a culture of continuous improvement through data-driven insights, rigorous testing, and robust governance frameworks.  
  
Impact Transform how 500,000+ Amazonians plan travel, book events, manage payments, and submit expenses — replacing fragmented, manual processes with a unified AI-powered experience that scales globally Drive measurable operational efficiencies by reducing cycle times, manual touchpoints, and error rates in complex travel and expense workflows Influence the automation and AI strategy for one of Amazon's largest employee-facing platforms.  
  
A day in the life

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 7+ years of engineering experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

### **Description**

**Role Summary**  
The Stats Developer builds, supports, and improves the systems and integrations that power live sports statistics across DAZN/Fox Sports products and broadcast workflows. The role focuses on ingesting, validating, transforming, and publishing sports data from third-party providers and internal capture systems so it can be used reliably by digital products, broadcast graphics, and internal stakeholders.  
This role sits at the intersection of sports data, live operations, product delivery, and stakeholder support — covering provider integrations, internal capture platforms, broadcast data feeds, and operational support for a 24x7 sports data environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Sports Data Integrations**

* Build, maintain, and support integrations with external sports data providers including, but not limited to Sport radar and Champion Data.
* Support real-time and near-real-time ingestion pipelines for sports such as AFL, Netball, NRL, Cricket, Football, Basketball, Motorsport, and others as required
* Map provider data into internal schemas and publishing models used by APIs, widgets, broadcast systems, and internal tools
* Investigate and resolve issues with incoming feeds, data quality, sequencing, match states, and downstream publishing
* Support changes required when providers update feed structures, fields, or delivery patterns

**Internal Stats Capture Support**

* Support and enhance in-house stats capture systems used for sports including NRL and Cricket
* Work closely with the internal stats division to ensure captured data is correctly stored, validated, published, and displayed
* Help maintain the tools and workflows used for live capture, correction, validation, and display of match statistics
* Support internal users of capture and display systems during live events and operational windows
* Assist with issue triage, defect resolution, and continuous improvement of internal stats workflow

**Broadcast and Graphics Support**

* Delivering and maintaining data feeds for OB graphics and Virtual Eye

title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the Yocto-based build infrastructure and board support software that enable AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGAs. You will own the layers, distributions, and toolchains that turn new AMD silicon into a buildable, supportable software platform for Linux, OpenBMC, and real-time workloads.

Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, kernel and firmware teams, and the Yocto and OpenEmbedded communities, you will take new silicon from first power-on to a supportable, upstreamable platform, and build the images, SDKs, and reference designs customers develop against.

**THE PERSON:**

The ideal candidate is passionate about embedded Linux and build systems, and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in Yocto and board support package development, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through silicon bring-up and into production.

You are comfortable across the full stack, from a device tree node to a released SDK, and collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Yocto Build Infrastructure:** Design and maintain the Yocto and OpenEmbedded layers that enable new AMD silicon — SoC family definitions, machine configurations, tunes, and layer architecture across BSP and distro layers.
* **Kernel, Bootloader and Boot Image Integration:** Integrate recipes for the Linux kernel, U-Boot, TF-A, and platform firmware, and build the boot artifact pipeline — device tree packaging, flash layout, signing, secure boot, and golden-image recovery.
* **Multi-Domain Builds and SDKs:** Define multiconfig builds that produce Linux, RTOS, firmware, and programmable logic artifacts together, and deliver the SDKs and toolchains teams develop against.
* **Adaptive SoC and Programmable Logic:** Integrate programmable logic into the software stack, including bitstream packaging, device tree overlays, and enabling PL interfaces from Linux.
* **Silicon and Board Bring-Up:** Participate in new silicon and board bring-up from first power-on, holding the integrated image and driving issues to root cause with hardware and firmware teams.
* **CI, Release and Technical Leadership:** Maintain QEMU-based virtual platforms and continuous integration, deliver release artifacts and software bills of materials, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Deep hands-on experience with the **Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, and BitBake** — authoring recipes, bbappends, and classes, building BSP and distro layers, SDK generation, and diagnosing complex build failures.
* Strong **embedded Linux** and board support package background: the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint, device trees, kernel configuration and fragments, driver enablement, and bootloaders and early firmware such as **U-Boot and TF-A**.
* Familiarity with **BMC products and the platform management domain**, and interfaces such as I2C, SPI, eSPI, and PECI.
* Strong programming skills in **C and C++**, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting for build and automation work.
* Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning build systems, operating systems, drivers, bootloaders, and firmware, and familiarity with **Git and CI/CD** workflows.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with **AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies**, including AMD Vivado™ or Vitis™ and hardware/software co-design.
* **Zephyr or another embedded RTOS**, and **RISC-V** or other non-x86 architectures, including board enablement and toolchain integration.
* Inter-processor communication frameworks such as **OpenAMP** in heterogeneous multi-core systems.
* Experience with **OpenBMC** or a comparable BMC software stack and its integration into a Yocto distribution.
* **QEMU** or comparable virtual platforms for pre-silicon development and continuous integration.
* Experience developing **reference designs or proof-of-concept solutions**, and release engineering at scale including SBOM and CVE triage.
* Contributions to the Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, or Linux open-source projects, with strong analytical and communication skills and demonstrated technical leadership.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

---------------

Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.  
  
WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.  
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.  
  
As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.  
  
We are looking for software engineers with 4+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

title: Associate Operations Software Engineer - Operations ( Contract to hire )
description:
About Signant Health
  
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Associate Operations Software Engineer creates, enhances, and maintains business applications, configures custom code to support the company’s business needs, and moves those configurations through a standard SDLC progression. The Engineer is accountable for project deliverables in line with quality targets and SLAs, while adhering to best practices, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), company processes, and global industry regulations. The ideal candidate has basic product knowledge and basic knowledge of user applications.
  
  
This is a 6-month contract role with the potential to convert to a full-time position (contract-to-hire).
  
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function
  
  
Application Development / Study Configuration
  

* Develop and maintain application components (under supervision)
* Support Global Technical Delivery in meeting business objectives outlined in Goals and Objectives
* Work with the Solutions team to understand business requirements for assigned tasks
* Support all phases of verification and testing by efficiently diagnosing and resolving defects
* Collaborate with the Delivery Manager/Lead to keep projects on time
* Coordinate with the Software Engineering team to understand design patterns, standards, customizations, and resource capacity planning
* Understand and follow all coding standards
* Create robust, well-documented code
* Design, create, and modify database objects as required
* Complete unit testing, create documentation, and execute peer reviews as required
* Adhere to source control, versioning best practices, and operational process requirements when executing study configuration tasks
* Regularly communicate status updates on assigned tasks to internal and external stakeholders
* Request requirements and design clarifications when necessary
* Willingly and openly adopt and support iterative process improvements
* Job performance is measured individually, as it pertains to team goals aligned with corporate objectives for Global Technical Delivery and the values of Signant Health

Site Support Responsibilities (Rater Station only)
  

* Adhere to source control, versioning best practices, and operational process requirements
* Perform general site support in support of study configurations in the field, as required
* Diagnose and resolve defects as part of general site support
* Prepare and confirm all required change control documentation, including updates to design and other technical documents
* Deploy resolutions to testing and production environments as required

Quality System Responsibilities
  

* Perform all work in accordance with documented Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Working Instructions, and adhere to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), 21 CFR Part 11, and other regulatory requirements as required

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
  
  
**Essential:**  

* 0–2 years of experience developing software
* Conceptual knowledge of software development processes and practices
* Programming experience in any language (classroom or professional experience)
* Knowledge of application development, configuration, and support areas
* Ability to work independently and resourcefully toward quality, high-performance solutions
* Problem-solving skills and good decision-making, with the judgment to escalate when necessary
* Ability to provide concise, accurate status updates to the team on progress
* Ability to establish and maintain effective work relationships within and across functional areas
* Analytical skills, with the ability to comprehend business requirements

**Specific to IRT and Rater Station products:**  

* Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio, SQL Server Reporting Services, and T-SQL
* Microsoft Visual Studio IDE, ASP.NET MVC, and C# with LINQ

**Desirable:**  

* Agile Scrum methodologies
* Atlassian Suite tools such as Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira, Xray, and Jira Service Management
* Source control software such as Team Foundation Server, Bitbucket, or other Git-based tools
* Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and Reporting Services (SSRS)
* Microsoft Azure, Cosmos DB, and Kubernetes
* REST APIs
* Web code and data standards: HTML, JavaScript, XML, JSON, and REST
* Experience leading software design and development efforts on assigned projects
* Experience estimating project time for quoting development and support tasks
* Willingness to share knowledge openly with others, including lessons learned
* Willingness to work flexible hours
* Familiarity with GCP and 21 CFR Part 11
* Familiarity with defect tracking software

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

TimeHub is chartered to build a world-class Time & Attendance platform that powers the full lifecycle of time tracking and pay computation for over 1.8 million hourly associates across Amazon's global operations — spanning Fulfillment Centers, Delivery Stations, Customer Service and other business lines. Our systems sit on the critical path of Amazon operations: every shift worked, every time-off request, every accrual balance, and every paycheck generated flows through our platform. Getting it right matters — accuracy, reliability, and speed directly impact associate trust, pay correctness, and regulatory compliance across 65+ countries.  
  
Are you a seasoned engineering leader who thrives on building high-performing teams and solving complex, real-world problems at massive scale? We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team within TimeHub, owning critical components of the Time & Attendance ecosystem. In this role, you will own a multi-year technical strategy for your team's domain, drive engineering excellence, and partner closely with product management, Amazonian Experience technology, and operations stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes for Amazon's workforce worldwide. You will tackle challenges unique to this space — computing pay accurately across thousands of policy configurations, ensuring sub-second latency for real-time time capture, and scaling systems that process hundreds of millions of transactions weekly.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the technical vision and architecture for Amazon time-off management and pay policy execution — designing scalable, fault-tolerant systems that compute accurately across thousands of policy configurations and regional regulations.
* Build and lead a high-performing team — recruit, coach, and retain top talent; mentor engineers across levels.
* Raise the engineering excellence bar — drive best practices in code quality, design reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD, and documentation to ensure long-term maintainability and developer velocity.
* Drive operational excellence — own service health, on-call, monitoring, and post-mortem rigor for pay-critical systems.
* Define and prioritize the product roadmap — make crisp trade-offs between new capability development, tech debt reduction, and operational hardening in partnership with product, payroll, and compliance stakeholders.
* Drive cross-team alignment across TimeHub, Scheduling, DLS, WSTT, PXT, and Operations — removing blockers and ensuring seamless delivery across the time-to-pay pipeline.

  
About the team  
We build low-latency, highly scalable policy computation and storage layers that power the full spectrum of Time-Off and Pay processing across multiple businesses and regions. We use cutting edge technologies from AWS and continuously challenge ourselves in building the right solution.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of engineering experience
* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Mainframe CICS Systems Programmer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, and maintain CICS environments.
* Manage CICSplex infrastructure.
* Support transaction processing environments.
* Troubleshoot availability and performance issues.
* Support upgrades and migrations.
* Ensure resiliency and disaster recovery readiness.
Integrate CICS with DB2, MQ, RACF, and z/OS services.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

### **Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 5 to 7 years of experience in IBM Mainframe technologies.
* Strong experience in IBM CICS Transaction Server (CICS TS) administration, including CICSPlex SM, CICS region management, and transaction processing.
* Expertise in CICS performance tuning, recovery management, diagnostics, dump analysis, and problem determination.
* Experience integrating CICS with IBM MQ, DB2, RACF, and z/OS subsystems.
* Knowledge of high-availability, workload management, and mission-critical transaction processing environments.
Experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2016/2019, VMware ESX, and public/private cloud environments, including on-premises to cloud migrations.  

  

### **Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Experience with CICSPlex SM, CICS upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and release management.
* Knowledge of OMEGAMON for CICS, CICS Explorer, JCL, SMP/E, and REXX.
* Familiarity with Parallel Sysplex, workload balancing, disaster recovery, and resilience architectures.
* Understanding of ITIL Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Experience with automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), vulnerability management, Active Directory, and ADFS.
Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**Automation & AI Agentic Engineer** (Intelligent Automation Developer)

**You'll have opportunity to:**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy automation solutions using **UiPath** and **Microsoft Power Automate**, following CoE development standards and reusable component libraries.
* Build and orchestrate **AI agents** using **Agent Core**, **UiPath Agentic Automation** (agentic orchestration, agent-to-agent/human-in-the-loop workflows), and **Microsoft Copilot Studio** for goal-driven, autonomous or semi-autonomous process automation.
* Use **GitHub Copilot** (chat, inline completion, agent mode) to accelerate development, code review, and testing across automation and supporting application code.

* Implement AI components where required: document/IDP processing, LLM-based reasoning steps, prompt design, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns for knowledge-grounded agents.
* Apply governance, security, and responsible-AI practices: exception handling, logging/observability, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, data privacy, and bias/hallucination mitigation for agentic components.
* Participate in solution design reviews (PDD/SDD), UAT, hypercare, and production support/incident triage for deployed bots and agents.
* Maintain documentation for developed solutions, including agent decision logic, guardrails, and rollback/fallback procedures.
* Collaborate with Solution Leads/Architects on scalability, CI/CD pipeline integration, and CoE standards adoption; mentor junior developers on both RPA and agentic development practices.

* Proficiency with REST APIs, JSON/XML, SQL, and at least one scripting/programming language (Python, VB.NET, or C#).

UiPath

**Modernization strategy (from .NET MVC to cloud-native)**

**AWS cloud-native implementation**

Design and guide build-out of cloud foundations required for modern apps (networking, environments, security, observability, CI/CD).

**Migration to existing AWS/Java (Spring/Hibernate) platforms**

Partner with platform owners to ensure migrated components comply with existing Java platform conventions and deployment pipelines.

**Security, compliance, and risk management**

Embed secure engineering practices (threat modelling participation, secure coding standards, dependency hygiene).

Identify technical risks early (data migration risk, downtime, coupling, unknown dependencies) and drive mitigation plans.

Advanced Python

title: Developer II
description:
Overview:

As a Software Developer II on the Smart Water pod, you will build the customer-facing Smart Water experience inside the RealPage Smart Building Portal and the services behind it. You will work across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL, integrating meter and usage data from upstream systems.

A core part of the mission is making Smart Water scale: replacing today's manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service workflows, hardening the data-ingestion pipeline, and building water-usage anomaly detection that flags running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, and abnormal consumption for operators.

This role suits a developer with a few years of full-stack experience who wants to own medium-sized features end to end in a small, high-ownership pod and grow into the product's AI roadmap (a Smart Water MCP that powers a Lumina Copilot).

Responsibilities:

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Smart Water features across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL.
* Integrate meter, usage, and occupancy data from upstream systems and improve the reliability of the ingestion pipeline.
* Develop water-usage anomaly detection that surfaces sustained anomalies (running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, abnormal usage) from interval meter data.
* Replace manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service setup and data-management workflows.
* Surface Smart Water inside the Smart Building Portal (SBP) and contribute to the Smart Water MCP that powers Lumina AI workflows.
* Write clean, well-tested code and partner closely with the pod's QA engineer on quality and data integrity.

Qualifications:

This is a full-stack role on a C#/.NET 8 and Angular codebase backed by MSSQL.

* 2+ years building production software, full-stack or backend-leaning.
* Proficiency in C#/.NET (ASP.NET Web API) and solid SQL / relational data-modeling skills (MSSQL).
* Front-end experience with Angular or a similar modern framework.
* Experience integrating and consuming REST APIs and working with upstream/third-party data sources.
* Comfort writing tested, maintainable code and working in a CI/CD workflow (Azure DevOps).
* Extensive hands-on experience with Claude Code or a similar agentic coding harness (required).
* Demonstrated experience with agentic coding workflows — using AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development (required).

**Preferred Skills but not** **required**

* Experience with data-pipeline / ingestion work and diagnosing data-quality issues.
* Exposure to IoT, metering, or utility/submetering domains.
* Experience with ElasticSearch.
* Interest in applied AI — building MCP servers or LLM-powered features (e.g., a Lumina Copilot).
* Familiarity with OIDC / single sign-on integration.

description:

**Role Overview:**

  

Do you love building software that thrills your customers using AIDLC? Do you insist on high standards for the systems you and your teams design and build? Are you a progressive, hands-on software engineer with an architect’s mindset, an advocate of agile development practices, and a proponent of continuous improvement? Well if this is you, then join an energetic team of engineers building next generation applications for PDI! Software Engineer 4 is our senior-most engineering level and operates at the scope of a Software Architect. You will own the technical architecture and solution design for your product area as we drive to continuously increase our cloud maturity and mobility, defining how services are structured, integrated, secured, and scaled, and making the key design decisions for new and existing applications. You will lead medium and large sized projects, set technical direction and engineering standards across teams, and guide, train, and mentor engineers at all levels. You will partner with Product Management, Software Architects, and DevOps on solution feasibility, estimation, and the technical roadmap, and serve as the evangelist and custodian of our technology, architecture, and product. With the variety of environments, platforms, technologies & languages, you must be comfortable working in both Windows & Linux environments and learning a variety of programming languages.  
  
This is a hands-on architect-level position (~60% hands-on design and coding, ~40% architecture, technical leadership, and mentoring) requiring expert proficiency in .NET Core, React, SQL Server, and cloud-native architecture on Azure, with ownership of system design, architectural decisions, and engineering quality across teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture and solution design for your product area, and be accountable for design decisions for new and existing applications, proactively escalating issues and seeking assistance to overcome obstacles.
* Define and document target-state architecture, system designs, and architecture decision records (ADRs); run design reviews and ensure implementations stay consistent with the agreed architecture.
* Design for non-functional requirements (scalability, availability, performance, security, and compliance such as PCI DSS) and make the trade-offs between them explicit.
* Define service boundaries, API contracts, integration patterns (REST, messaging and event-driven), and data models across services and third-party systems.
* Lead medium and large sized projects end-to-end, from architecture and design through production deployment.
* Set technical direction, coding standards, and engineering best practices across teams; guide, train, and mentor engineers at all levels, including through code and design reviews.
* Actively design, develop, and maintain critical services and enterprise applications using .NET Framework, .NET Core, and React, building reference implementations and proofs of concept.
* Partner with Product Management to consult on solution feasibility, high-level effort estimation, and the technical roadmap.
* Prepare and provide project status and risk assessments, including technical and architectural risks, to management with appropriate levels of detail to ensure programs stay on schedule.
* Collaborate with Software Architects and DevOps teams to evaluate tools, processes, technologies, and cloud infrastructure, including build-versus-buy decisions.
* Make recommendations for technology adoption and framework improvement, analyzing trends, patterns, and best practices for software, including AI-assisted development (AIDLC).
* Serve as the evangelist and custodian of technology, architecture, and product.
* Identify systemic performance, reliability, and scalability risks; drive root-cause analysis of production incidents and the architectural fixes that follow.
* Use a disciplined approach in an Agile environment to assist in analysis and determination of preferred solutions to technical challenges.
* Troubleshoot, test, and validate software issues; resolve issues with due urgency and maintain thorough documentation of all software solutions.
* Work with Product Owner to clarify and estimate feature work, and with QA Engineers to develop optimal product test plans and resolve issues found during release stabilization.
* Own the technical debt roadmap: identify, prioritize, and drive modernization and improvements across teams.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field plus 9+ years’ experience designing, developing, and maintaining software applications in a software product development environment, OR equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of experience serving as a technical team lead or in an architecture role.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering distributed, cloud-native systems end-to-end, including microservices, event-driven architecture, and API design.
* Expert in: .NET Framework, .Net/.NET Core, C#, SQL, ASP.NET, ASP.NET Core, MVC, REST API, React.
* Strong knowledge of architecture and design principles: design patterns, domain-driven design, SOLID, scalability, resiliency patterns, caching, and messaging (for example, Azure Service Bus).
* Strong experience with SQL Server and NoSQL data stores (for example, Cosmos DB): data modeling, stored procedures, and query performance tuning.
* Deep knowledge of C# development including: multi-threading, memory management, async programming, microservices, dependency injection.
* 3+ years of experience designing and running cloud native applications on Azure (or AWS/GCP): Infrastructure as a Service, Docker/containers, CI/CD, and observability.
* Understanding of application security and compliance (OWASP, PCI DSS), with experience in payments or other regulated domains preferred.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (AI-based agents) and the ability to drive their adoption across teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Visual Studio IDE and the use of Azure DevOps or Jira.
* 2+ years of practical experience with Agile development methodologies.
* Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others and take action.
* Requires strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms and present architecture to technical and business audiences.
* Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize tasks with competing deadlines.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to work under pressure.
* Considers ‘best-practice’ standards, as well as departmental policies and procedures.
* Experience working in retail or payments solution is preferred.

* Manages Complexity

description:
**Senior Software Performance Engineer**

*6+ Years Experience | PAX India*

**About the Role**
==================

Help scale the performance engineering discipline across Blackbaud — building the tooling, practices, and expertise that let dev and ops teams do their own performance analysis, while staying hands-on enough to solve the hardest problems yourself and mentor others.

Our core stack is Kubernetes/Azure-based microservices, though you'll occasionally support older, more monolithic systems too — the core skills (profiling, load testing, root-cause analysis) transfer directly.

This is a hands-on coding role: most of your time goes to building and maintaining our load/synthetic test tooling (including AI-assisted testing) and integrating it into our SDLC. The rest is split between observability tooling and ad hoc performance analysis, with strong ownership of latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Load & Synthetic Test Tooling**
---------------------------------

* Build and maintain our synthetic/load-testing framework — test development (Playwright/Gatling), execution, and reporting.
* Apply AI capabilities to improve test development — AI-assisted authoring, scenario generation, result analysis.
* Integrate performance and synthetic tests into CI/CD pipelines so checks run continuously, not just ad hoc.

**Observability & Ad Hoc Performance Analysis**
-----------------------------------------------

* Improve observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, App Insights, AppDynamics, New Relic): dashboards, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, instrumentation.
* Run load, stress, and soak tests to catch bottlenecks before production; profile CPU, memory, GC, I/O, and network in C#/.NET and/or Java services.
* Troubleshoot production performance issues (latency regressions, resource exhaustion, throttling) and tune resource usage in Kubernetes/AKS (requests/limits, autoscaling, kubectl diagnostics).

**Ongoing**
-----------

* Build self-serve performance capabilities (dashboards, guardrails, docs) so teams can diagnose issues without escalating.
* Design and maintain C#/.NET and/or Java microservices with a focus on performance and scalability.
* Collaborate via Agile/GitHub workflows and mentor junior engineers on profiling and troubleshooting.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

* 6+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful exposure to performance, scalability, or reliability engineering.
* Strong C#/.NET and/or Java skills, plus strong Azure experience.
* Solid grasp of how compute resources (CPU, memory, I/O, network) drive performance/scalability, including tuning in containerized environments.
* Hands-on experience with a load-testing tool (k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling) and a browser-automation tool for synthetic/end-to-end testing (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).
* Experience with profiling tools (dotnet-trace, PerfView, App Insights profiler) and observability/APM tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, AppDynamics, New Relic).
* Some experience applying AI/LLM tools to dev workflows (AI-assisted coding, test generation, analysis).
* Experience integrating tooling/tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and troubleshooting production performance issues.
* Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals and networking basics (DNS, TLS, routing) as they relate to performance.
* Experience with Agile/GitHub, strong documentation and communication skills, and comfort working across time zones.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If You**

title: Sr. Snowflake Developer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Snowflake Developer / Data Engineer (IC3) to take self-directed ownership of features and small epics within our Snowflake data platform — including Bronze/Silver/Gold data layer architecture, ELT pipelines, and the data models that power analytics and reporting across Keyloop. Beyond hands-on delivery, you will lead design discussions for your own work, coach more junior developers, and work with stakeholders across Finance, Sales, and Operations to deliver reliable, scalable, and well-governed data products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead complete delivery of features and small epics on the Snowflake platform, from design through to production, without senior oversight
* Design and implement Snowflake database objects: tables, views, streams, tasks, stored procedures, and dynamic tables
* Build and maintain ELT pipelines using Boomi, dbt, or SQL-based transformations into Snowflake
* Architect and manage Bronze / Silver / Gold data layers in line with Keyloop's data platform standards
* Develop and optimise complex SQL for data transformation, aggregation, and reporting use cases
* Implement Snowflake performance best practices: clustering keys, result caching, query profiling, and warehouse right-sizing
* Own testing strategy for pipeline and model changes, ensuring comprehensive coverage beyond unit-level checks
* Coach and support IC1/IC2 developers on Snowflake, SQL, and data engineering best practices
* Lead technical design discussions for your features and represent the team in cross-functional planning meetings
* Coordinate cross-functional data requirements with adjacent teams (Finance, Sales, Operations)
* Support data quality checks, reconciliation processes, and lineage documentation
* Manage Snowflake environment configuration across dev, QA, and production
* Contribute to data governance: access control, data masking, row-level security, and tagging
* Monitor pipeline health, proactively identify failures, and provide production support — including occasional out-of-hours incident response
* Support UAT cycles with technical recommendations and sign-off
* Produce clear technical documentation: data dictionaries, ERDs, pipeline runbooks

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4–7 years of Snowflake development experience in a production data environment
* Strong SQL skills — window functions, CTEs, recursive queries, and advanced aggregations
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake-specific features: streams, tasks, dynamic tables, time travel, zero-copy cloning
* Experience building ELT/ETL pipelines from source systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, or ERP platforms
* Understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing concepts (star schema, slowly changing dimensions)
* Familiarity with Snowflake access controls: roles, grants, and row/column-level security
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD for data pipeline deployment
* Ability to translate business data requirements into technical data models
* Demonstrated ability to coach or mentor junior developers, and to lead technical discussions within a team

**Desirable Skills**

* SnowPro Core or Advanced Data Engineer certification
* Experience with dbt (data build tool) for transformation orchestration
* Exposure to Boomi as an integration tool feeding Snowflake
* Familiarity with Salesforce data structures and Salesforce reporting requirements
* Experience with NetSuite financial data extraction and modelling
* Knowledge of data observability tooling (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, or similar)
* Experience working within Agile delivery teams and Jira-based project management
* Background in automotive, SaaS, or financial systems data

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

title: Sr Developer
description:
**Job Summary**

Sr Developer role in an MNC focused on building scalable UiPath automation solutions that streamline enterprise processes and enhance operational efficiency. The role involves owning complex robotic workflows mentoring peers in automation standards and partnering with business teams to design reliable digital workers. This position operates in a hybrid work model with day shift and no travel required.

**Responsibilities**

* Design advanced UiPath automation workflows that transform complex business processes into efficient digital solutions while ensuring reliability and maintainability for long term enterprise use.
* Develop reusable UiPath components and libraries that standardize automation patterns across teams and reduce duplication of effort while improving overall quality and performance of delivered solutions.
* Analyze existing manual workflows with business stakeholders and translate them into detailed UiPath process designs that clearly define inputs outputs exceptions and success criteria for each automation.
* Configure UiPath Orchestrator settings and deployment routines to ensure robust scheduling monitoring and governance of robots across environments while maintaining strict compliance with organizational standards.
* Implement detailed logging exception handling and alerting within UiPath automation solutions to support effective production support rapid incident resolution and continuous improvement activities.
* Collaborate closely with UiPath citizen developers to review their automation designs provide practical guidance and ensure that citizen developed solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and security policies.
* Perform rigorous unit integration and user acceptance testing on UiPath workflows to validate functional correctness performance stability and adherence to business requirements before production release.
* Optimize existing UiPath automations by identifying bottlenecks improving activity usage and refining workflows to reduce execution time resource consumption and operational risk for the organization.
* Document end to end automation designs including process definition documents solution design documents and support runbooks to enable effective handover and ongoing maintenance by the broader technology team.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business teams by proposing UiPath automation opportunities that deliver measurable value support strategic goals and contribute to more accessible services for customers and communities.
* Provide structured mentoring to junior developers and citizen developers by sharing best practices coding standards and troubleshooting techniques that raise overall team capability in UiPath automation.
* Coordinate with cross functional teams in a hybrid work setting to prioritize automation backlog manage dependencies and ensure timely delivery of high impact UiPath solutions during day shift operations.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate deep practical experience in designing developing and deploying UiPath automation solutions across multiple modules including studio orchestrator and relevant activities for large scale environments.
* Show proven hands on expertise in guiding and supporting UiPath citizen developers by reviewing their workflows offering constructive feedback and ensuring safe and sustainable automation adoption.
* Apply strong understanding of robotic process automation concepts process assessment criteria and exception handling strategies to deliver automations that are resilient auditable and aligned with organizational policies.
* Leverage solid knowledge of software development principles such as modular design version control testing and documentation to create UiPath solutions that are easy to maintain and extend over time.
* Use effective communication and collaboration skills to work with business analysts operations teams and other technical specialists in a hybrid work model without requiring travel while supporting day shift engagements.
* Demonstrate familiarity with enterprise security and compliance expectations for automation including appropriate handling of credentials data privacy and role based access configurations within UiPath tools.
* Exhibit strong analytical and problem solving capabilities that enable rapid diagnosis of production issues performance constraints and design flaws within UiPath workflows followed by practical remediation.

**Certifications Required**

UiPath Certified Advanced RPA Developer or equivalent UiPath professional certification

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Full Stack Software Developer to join our growing engineering team, building cloud-native SaaS platforms for the insurance industry.
  
You will help design and develop scalable distributed systems and shared services that support multiple products used by insurers, suppliers, police forces and supporting organisations across the UK and internationally.
  
Our platform is evolving towards a modern AWS-native architecture, making extensive use of serverless technologies, microservices and event-driven systems to deliver highly scalable and reliable solutions.
  
You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from architecture and design through to deployment and operational support, collaborating with engineers, product managers and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
  
This role is ideal for developers who enjoy building scalable cloud services, solving complex technical problems, and continuously improving how software is delivered.

  

You will work with technologies such as:
  

* AWS Lambda, Step Functions and API Gateway
* .NET-based microservices
* RESTful APIs and shared platform services
* Event-driven integrations
* CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments
* Scalable SaaS systems used across the UK insurance market

The work you contribute to will help insurers process claims faster, improve decision making and deliver better outcomes for customers.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design and develop cloud-native SaaS applications and shared platform services
* Build scalable microservices and serverless components using modern development practices
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrations with internal systems and third-party platforms
* Contribute to the design and evolution of distributed and event-driven architectures
* Work across new product development, enhancements and platform evolution
* Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives
* Collaborate with Product Managers to refine requirements, estimate work and deliver features iteratively
* Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes
* Investigate and resolve production issues, providing third-level technical support where required
* Produce and maintain technical documentation and architectural artefacts
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices, tooling and platform reliability

  

Qualifications
  
Essential Requirements
  

* 3+ years professional experience building commercial software systems
* Strong experience developing server-side applications using C# and .NET Core
* Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and JSON-based integrations
* Experience working with SQL databases (Microsoft SQL Server or PostgreSQL preferred)
* Experience building or deploying applications on AWS cloud infrastructure
* Familiarity with microservices or distributed system architecture
* Experience using Git or modern source control systems
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments, such as ADO
* Experience using Visual Studio or equivalent development environments
* A passion for technology and a desire to continuously learn and improve

Highly Desirable
  

* Experience working with AWS serverless services (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway)
* Front-end development experience with Vue.js, React, Angular or modern JavaScript frameworks
* Experience working within Agile / Scrum development environments
* Knowledge of event-driven architecture or message bus technologies
* Experience implementing Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Understanding of software design patterns and clean architecture principles
* Experience building microservices-based platforms
* Familiarity with AI development tools or AI-assisted engineering workflows
* Knowledge of Low Code / No Code platforms
* Experience working within the insurance or financial services industry

What We’re Looking For
  
We’re particularly interested in developers who enjoy building scalable cloud services and shared platform capabilities, and who are comfortable working with modern distributed architectures on AWS.
  
You should be someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and contributing to the evolution of engineering practices within the team.

For more than 50 years, Verisk has helped property and casualty insurers make smarter decisions about risk through AI-powered risk modeling, advanced analytics, and technology solutions spanning the entire policy lifecycle. We are a leading strategic data, analytics, and technology partner to the global insurance industry, guided by core values of learning, caring, and results while maintaining the highest ethical standards as stewards of the industry's most comprehensive datasets. Learn more about Verisk and what we are doing within the insurance industry.

For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

title: Software Engineer, Associate
description:
### **Description**

We're growing our core engineering team and looking for seasoned Software Engineers to take ownership of building and scaling our platform end to end. You'll design and ship microservices in Java, build clean REST APIs, own front-end features, and increasingly work on agentic AI capabilities that connect large language models to our enterprise systems.  
This is a hands-on full-stack role for someone with strong engineering fundamentals who already builds with modern AI tooling and is curious about where it's headed. We value engineering depth and learning speed over years spent on any single emerging protocol.

  

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable microservices and RESTful APIs
* Build or use Agents to migrate the existing code-generated Java app to native Java.
* Build responsive front-end features and own them alongside the backend
* Develop agentic AI features, including RAG pipelines and MCP-based integrations that let LLMs securely interact with our data, tools, and services
* Apply prompt engineering techniques (few-shot, one-shot, chain-of-thought) as part of day-to-day development
* Make pragmatic architecture and design decisions, weighing trade-offs around scale, cost, and maintainability
* Write clean, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews
* Collaborate with product and cross-functional teams to turn requirements into working software
* Help set engineering standards and mentor other developers where it adds value

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 1-3 years of professional software engineering experience (full-stack)
* Strong proficiency in Java and hands-on experience designing and building microservices architectures (Spring Boot or equivalent)
* Strong in PostgreSQL.
* Solid track record of building RESTful API endpoints that are clean, secure, and maintainable
* Front-end experience with Angular or React — able to build clean, responsive UIs
* Experience building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications or pipelines
* Strong working knowledge of prompt engineering — few-shot, one-shot, and chain-of-thought — used on a day-to-day basis
* Comfortable with vibe coding and AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code,Kiro, Cursor, Copilot), paired with strong underlying technical judgment
* Strong grasp of relational and/or NoSQL databases and data modeling
* Comfortable working in Agile teams and delivery processes

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Python for AI agent logic, MCP server/client development, and custom integrations
* DevOps / cloud experience — deploying applications to production using Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift
* Hands-on with AWS and CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with agent frameworks and orchestration (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar)
* Exposure to LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI)
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, pgvector, ChromaDB)
* Prior experience in a technical lead or mentorship role
